title: hopify Funnel Builder (GemPages) & Dropshipping Manager
description:
## About Us



We are a fast-growing ecommerce company operating multiple Shopify brands across different markets.



We are looking for a highly experienced Shopify Funnel Builder (GemPages) & Dropshipping Manager who can take ownership of store operations, funnel building, reporting, localization, and conversion optimization.



This is NOT an entry-level Shopify VA position.



We are looking for someone who can work independently, execute quickly, solve problems, manage multiple stores, and keep operations organized without constant supervision.



---



# Minimum Requirements



### Experience



* Minimum 2 years Shopify experience

* Minimum 2 years GemPages experience

* Experience managing multiple stores and brands

* Experience working in ecommerce and dropshipping

* Experience with funnel building and conversion optimization



### Personal Qualities



* Strong attention to detail

* Punctual and reliable

* Dedicated and proactive

* Able to work independently

* Strong communication skills

* Comfortable providing daily updates and reports

* WhatsApp is mandatory



---



# Core Responsibilities



## Daily & Monthly P&L Reporting (Heavy Focus)



You will be responsible for tracking profitability across multiple stores and brands.



### Daily P&L Reporting



* Update Daily P&L sheets

* Track Revenue

* Track COGS

* Track Ad Spend

* Track Fees

* Track Refunds

* Track Gross Profit

* Identify profitable and losing stores

* Flag unusual changes in performance



### Monthly P&L Reporting



* Prepare Monthly P&L reports

* Consolidate store performance data

* Analyze profitability by store and brand

* Compare month-over-month performance

* Provide operational insights and recommendations



---



## Shopify Store Operations



* Manage multiple Shopify stores

* Create and manage products

* Manage variants and collections

* Create offers and promotions

* Maintain store settings

* Setup and maintain legal pages

* Perform daily store audits

* Perform QA before launches

* Troubleshoot store issues



---



## Funnel Building (Heavy Focus)



Using GemPages:



* Build product pages

* Build advertorial pages

* Build landing pages

* Clone funnels from internal brands

* Recreate funnels from competitor stores

* Export and import GemPages pages

* Update and optimize existing funnels

* Publish and maintain pages



---



## Product Page & Advertorial Management



* Create and update product pages

* Create and update advertorials

* Add FAQs

* Add images and videos

* Add new sections

* Implement competitor research

* Improve conversion rates



---



## Upsells & Conversion Optimization



* Setup One Click Upsell (OCU)

* Create post-purchase upsells

* Create downsells

* Setup subscriptions

* Setup Kaching Bundles

* Create quantity breaks

* Create bundle offers

* Optimize Average Order Value (AOV)



---



## Localization



* Localize pages from one language to another

* Translate funnels and advertorials

* Adapt offers to different markets

* Work with German and French stores



---



## Creative & AI Asset Implementation



* Generate landing page images using AI tools

* Implement images and creative assets into funnels

* Work closely with graphic designers and video editors

* Maintain visual consistency across stores



---



# Required Software & App Experience



Applicants should already be familiar with most of the following:



### Shopify



* Shopify Admin

* Shopify Themes



### Funnel Building



* GemPages



### Upsells & Conversion



* One Click Upsell (OCU)

* Kaching Bundles

* Kaching Subscriptions

* UpCart Cart Drawer

* OptiMonk



### Reviews & Trust



* Loox Reviews



### Profit Tracking & Reporting



* SimplyCost

* Google Sheets



### Localization



* Translate & Adapt

* DeepL



### Fulfillment & Logistics



* Speedfulfill

* easyDHL

* Dianxiaomi (???)



### Marketing



* Klaviyo



### Assets & File Management



* Fileflare

* Google Drive



### Communication



* WhatsApp (Mandatory)



### AI Tools



* ChatGPT

* AI Image Generation Tools



---



# What Success Looks Like



The ideal candidate:



Builds funnels quickly and accurately



Understands GemPages deeply



Can manage multiple stores at once



Keeps P&L reports updated daily



Understands upsells, bundles, and subscriptions



Provides timely updates and reports



Can work with minimal supervision



Maintains organized documentation



Solves problems proactively



Takes ownership of assigned projects



---



# Application Requirements



Please include:



1. Resume

2. Shopify stores you have worked on

3. Examples of GemPages funnels you built

4. Examples of landing pages, advertorials, or product pages you created

5. List of Shopify apps you have experience with

6. Years of Shopify experience

7. Expected monthly salary

8. WhatsApp number



Applications without Shopify and GemPages examples will not be considered.

title: Freelance Short-Form Video Editor
description:
Company: Global School Scout

Salary: $300 USD/month

Schedule: Flexible (task-based, no set working hours)

Location: Remote



About Us



Global School Scout (GSS) is an international education platform helping teachers find opportunities around the world. We connect educators with schools, provide resources for teachers moving abroad, and create content about teaching, travel, and international experiences.



We are looking for a creative video editor to join our team on a freelance basis and help us create engaging content for TikTok, Instagram Reels, YouTube Shorts,

You will be responsible for editing:



• 4–5 short-form videos per week (30–90 seconds)

• 1–2 longer videos per month when needed



Your tasks include:



• Editing raw video footage into engaging social media content

• Adding captions/subtitles

• Adding music, sound effects, transitions, and B-roll

• Creating strong hooks to improve viewer retention

• Adding graphics, images, and simple animations when needed

• Adjusting videos for TikTok, Instagram Reels, YouTube Shorts, and



Requirements



We are looking for someone who:



• Has experience editing short-form social media content

• Understands TikTok/Reels style editing

• Has good storytelling and pacing

• Can make educational content interesting

• Can work independently and meet deadlines

• Has strong attention to detail

• Is comfortable communicating in English



Experience with CapCut, Adobe Premiere Pro, After Effects, Canva, or similar editing tools is a plus.



Work Style



This is not an hourly position. We do not require you to be online during specific hours. We care about quality work and meeting deadlines.



You can work whenever you want as long as projects are completed on time.



How to Apply



Please send:



A short introduction about yourself

Examples of videos you have edited (portfolio links required)

The editing software you use

Your experience creating TikTok, Instagram Reels, or YouTube Shorts content



Send applications to:







Subject line:



Video Editor Application - Your Name



Applications without previous video examples will not be considered.



We are looking for someone creative who wants to grow with a new international education brand.

title: Social Media Officer
description:
JOB DESCRIPTION: SOCIAL MEDIA OFFICER



About BANTU Philippines

BANTU Philippines is a grassroots youth development organization in San Andres Bukid, Manila. Through a range of programs including Capoeira Angola, sports, dance, coaching and supporting nutrition, we work with street kids to build community, life skills and brighter futures.

CASA BANTU is our youth center — part home, part hangout, part martial arts, music, dance and art space. The aim is not to market ourselves as just a charity but as a social movement. 



The Role

We are looking for a Social Media Officer who understands what we do — and can translate it into content that moves people. You will manage BANTU's online presence with the creative freedom to bring our work and kids’ stories to life the way they deserve.

This is a part-time role. You will come on-site 1–2 times per month to shoot, and handle planning, writing, and editing remotely.



The Aesthetic & Voice

Young. Energetic. Authentic.

Raw when it needs to be — joyful when it needs to be. We do not do polished poverty porn. We do not do savior narratives. We show real kids doing extraordinary things.

Our voice is confident, nationalistic, and story-first. English proficiency is a necessity. Captions that move people, not perform for them.



Responsibilities

Plan and execute a monthly content calendar aligned with BANTU's campaigns and events

Shoot on-site 1–2 times per month, coordinated around program activities

Edit and post content across
, Instagram, Tiktok and LinkedIn

Write all captions in English (we discourage the use of 100% AI produced texts on socials) 

Coordinate with BANTU leadership on campaign messaging and brand consistency

Repurpose existing footage and photos when on-site shooting isn't needed



What You'll Need

Experience running social media for a brand, NGO, or community organization

Strong English writing — you should be able to tell a story in three sentences

Shooting and basic editing skills (phone-quality is fine if the eye is good)

Genuine alignment with BANTU's mission 

Ability to work independently with minimal supervision



Terms of Engagement

Type: Part-time, remote 

On-site: 1–2 shoot days per month, coordinated in advance

Remote: Content planning, writing, scheduling

Starting retainer: ?8,000/month. 



To Apply

Send your portfolio and with photo and video samples to: 





We review applications on a rolling basis.

title: VIDEO EDITOR (E-COMMERCE / DROPSHIPPING ADS)
description:
We are looking for a highly skilled Video Editor with extensive experience creating high-converting eCommerce and dropshipping video ads.



This is NOT a traditional video editing position.



We are looking for someone who can take a winning ad and create an exact duplicate of it in another language while maintaining the same structure, pacing, style, and viewing experience.



The ability to replicate videos with extreme accuracy is our most important requirement.



Responsibilities



* Create UGC Ads

* Create Podcast Ads

* Create AI-Generated Ads

* Generate videos using HeyGen and Higgsfield

* Extract and match background music from source videos

* Extract and match sound effects from source videos

* Follow scripts exactly

* Follow creative briefs exactly

* Create video ads in German, French, and English

* Deliver high-quality video ads with fast turnaround times

* Handle revisions quickly and professionally

* Work closely with Creative Strategists and Media Buyers



IMPORTANT REQUIREMENT



The most important skill for this position is the ability to create an EXACT DUPLICATE of an existing winning video ad.



We are NOT looking for editors who:



* Create their own version

* Add their own style

* Add their own creative ideas

* Take inspiration from the original video



We are looking for editors who can replicate a video exactly.



When given a source video, your job is to create a 1:1 copy of that video while changing only:



* Language

* Product name

* Brand name

* Avatar/Actor (when required)



Everything else should remain the same:



* Scene order

* Timing

* Pacing

* Background music

* Sound effects

* Transitions

* Captions

* Animations

* Visual effects

* Camera movement

* Structure

* Flow



The final output should feel like the original video was simply translated into another language.



Requirements



* Extensive experience with eCommerce and dropshipping video ads

* Extensive experience with UGC ads

* Extensive experience with Podcast ads

* Extensive experience with AI-generated ads

* Experience using HeyGen

* Experience using Higgsfield

* Strong understanding of direct-response advertising

* Strong attention to detail

* Ability to follow scripts exactly

* Ability to follow instructions exactly

* Experience editing videos in German, French, and English

* Ability to work fast without sacrificing quality

* Comfortable with revisions and feedback



Preferred Skills



* Experience working with Meta Ads

* Experience working with TikTok Ads

* Experience localizing ads into multiple languages

* Experience identifying winning ad structures

* Experience scaling eCommerce brands



To Apply



Please send:



* A brief introduction about yourself

* Your portfolio

* Examples of UGC Ads

* Examples of Podcast Ads

* Examples of AI-Generated Ads

* Your experience with HeyGen

* Your experience with Higgsfield

* Your availability



Screening Questions

mber who will stay and grow at our company. We offer competitive compensation and a good work environment.





WHAT YOU'LL DO

- Maintain brand consistency across every output, staying within each brand's color palette, lighting style, prop language, and overall aesthetic (HiEnd Accents vs. Paseo Road vs. our other brands)

- Obsessive attention to product accuracy: when comparing your AI output to the actual product photo, you catch the small stuff (a print motif that's slightly off, a flange width that's wrong by a quarter inch, a color that's a shade too warm) and fix it before delivery. The bar is exact match to the real product, not "looks close enough"



- Excellent English skills with high attention to detail and meticulous proofreading of any text or copy in your creatives

title: Amazon Private Label Product Research, Sourcing and Launch Specialist / Operations Lead
description:
Position: Amazon Private Label Product Research, Sourcing & Launch Specialist / Operations Lead



Type: Part-Time or Full-Time, Remote/Hybrid (Philippines)



Compensation: PHP 30,000 - 60,000 / month full-time equivalent, depending on level, experience, and proven Amazon Private Label capability. Specialist level: PHP 30,000 - 45,000 / month. Lead level: PHP 45,000 - 60,000 / month. Part-time compensation will be prorated based on agreed weekly hours.



Schedule: Full-time PH daytime hours or fixed part-time blocks, with flexibility for China supplier and Amazon-related communication.





About Our Company:



We are a Canadian corporation specialized in international trade and e-commerce. We operate in the global market and use ecommerce platforms such as Amazon to develop new brands and products for international customers. Our company values professionalism, data-driven decision-making, ownership, and long-term partnerships. We are building a strong, world-class team in the Philippines.





Role Overview:



We are hiring for this function across two levels: Amazon Private Label Specialist and Amazon Private Label Operations Lead. Both levels support our end-to-end Amazon private label operation, with the final level based on the candidate’s experience, judgment, ownership, and ability to work independently.



This is a hands-on Amazon Private Label role covering the full operation from product research and market analysis through supplier sourcing, product development, listing preparation, launch support, inventory and shipment coordination, Seller Central follow-up, post-launch monitoring, reporting, and ongoing process improvement.



Specialist-level candidates should be able to independently execute Amazon private label product research, supplier sourcing, competitor analysis, review analysis, listing support, launch preparation, and Amazon operations with strong accuracy, clear reporting, and good judgment. The specialist should be comfortable using SOPs and templates, but should not rely on step-by-step supervision for every task.



Lead-level candidates should be able to take ownership of Amazon private label opportunities end-to-end, including product research, sourcing direction, product improvement, supplier evaluation, launch planning, Amazon operations, and post-launch monitoring. The lead should be able to review work critically, guide execution quality, improve SOPs/templates, identify risks early, and make practical business recommendations with less supervision.



Candidates should have hands-on Amazon Private Label experience. General e-commerce, Shopify, dropshipping, social media, or basic Amazon VA experience is helpful only if it includes direct Amazon Private Label work.





Key Responsibilities:



•	Conduct or lead Amazon product research using Helium 10, Keepa, Amazon search, Amazon Seller Central data, and other available Amazon research tools.

•	Evaluate product opportunities using demand, pricing, competition, reviews, profitability, keyword opportunity, launch difficulty, differentiation potential, and operational risk.

•	Prepare clear product recommendations and explain the reasoning in a practical business-focused way.

•	Source and communicate with suppliers through Alibaba, 1688, Global Sources, and other sourcing platforms.

•	Request and compare supplier quotes, MOQ, lead time, sample cost, customization options, packaging options, compliance details, shipping details, and product improvement options.

•	Identify product improvement opportunities through review mining, competitor analysis, listing analysis, market gaps, customer complaints, and supplier capability checks.

•	Support product development by turning market findings, supplier options, and customer feedback into practical product specifications and improvement ideas.

•	Support or guide listing preparation, including keyword research, positioning, title and bullet inputs, image direction, A+ content inputs, competitor listing review, and product positioning.

•	Support launch preparation, including listing readiness, inventory planning, shipment coordination, sample follow-up, launch planning, missing-item follow-up, and blocker resolution.

•	Coordinate with designers, copywriters, PPC specialists, suppliers, prep centers, freight forwarders, or other contractors when needed.

•	Monitor Amazon Seller Central issues such as listing status, account health, suppressed listings, inventory status, customer feedback, returns, and operational risks.

•	Monitor post-launch performance, including sales, keyword movement, conversion signals, customer reviews, returns, stock level, pricing, PPC coordination, and competitor activity.

•	Prepare clear management updates with risks, blockers, recommended decisions, next actions, and execution priorities.

•	Keep Google Drive, Google Sheets, supplier records, product files, operation trackers, and Amazon operation documents organized and updated.

•	Flag weak assumptions, supplier risks, launch risks, listing risks, inventory risks, Amazon account concerns, or execution issues early.

•	For Lead-level candidates: review junior/support work, improve SOPs, templates, checklists, trackers, and help raise execution quality over time.





Qualifications:



•	Specialist level: 2-4+ years of direct Amazon Private Label experience preferred.

•	Lead level: 5-8+ years of direct Amazon Private Label experience preferred.

•	General Amazon FBA experience alone is not enough unless it includes hands-on Private Label work.

•	Experience with Amazon product research, supplier sourcing, product development, listing preparation, launch support, post-launch monitoring, and Amazon operations support.

•	Familiarity with Amazon Seller Central, Helium 10, Keepa, Alibaba, Google Sheets, Google Drive, and structured research templates.

•	Strong understanding of Amazon product research, keyword research, competitor analysis, review analysis, pricing, profitability, launch difficulty, and product differentiation.

•	Strong supplier communication and follow-up skills, especially with China-based suppliers.

•	Strong written English communication and clear reporting ability.

•	Highly organized, detail-oriented, and able to manage multiple product opportunities at different stages.

•	Comfortable following SOPs while also using judgment when a business decision requires practical thinking.

•	Comfortable using AI tools to improve research quality, analysis, judgment, workflow speed, and communication while verifying information carefully.

•	Able to work independently and provide clear updates, risks, decisions needed, and next steps.

•	Comfortable with both pre-launch and post-launch Amazon Private Label operations.





KPIs / Success Measures:



•	Quality and accuracy of Amazon product research, supplier sourcing, listing preparation, launch support, and operation files.

•	Quality of product opportunity judgment and ability to separate weak products from realistic launch candidates.

•	Accuracy of market data, competitor analysis, keyword research, review analysis, profitability assumptions, and launch planning inputs.

•	Quality of supplier outreach, quote comparison, product improvement requests, sample coordination, and supplier follow-up.

•	Ability to identify risks early before they affect product selection, supplier selection, launch timing, listing quality, inventory availability, or account performance.

•	Clear communication of blockers, risks, next steps, tradeoffs, and recommended decisions.

•	Low error rate in data entry, supplier details, Amazon listing details, cost assumptions, and research reports.

•	Reliable ownership across product research, sourcing, product development, launch preparation, Seller Central follow-up, and post-launch monitoring.

•	For Lead-level candidates: ability to improve execution quality, guide junior/support work, and improve SOPs, templates, or trackers when needed.

•	Consistent ability to follow company instructions, SOPs, policies, and communication standards while also applying sound judgment.





What We Offer:



•	Part-time or full-time remote work opportunity with a Canadian company.

•	Opportunity to work across the full Amazon private label process from product research to post-launch operations.

•	Long-term opportunity as the Amazon private label business grows.

•	Structured SOPs, templates, and process support.

•	Direct communication with company management.

•	Opportunity to grow into higher ownership based on proven capability and results.

•	Performance-based growth opportunities based on ownership, reliability, and execution quality.





Application Instructions:



To apply, please include the phrase "Amazon PL Role" in the first line of your application and answer the following questions briefly:

1.	Are you applying for Specialist level, Lead level, or open to either level based on assessment?

2.	Are you applying for full-time or part-time work? If part-time, how many hours per week can you consistently commit?

3.	How many years of direct Amazon Private Label experience do you have?

4.	Which Amazon tools have you used directly? Please mention Helium 10, Keepa, Seller Central, Alibaba, or others if applicable.

5.	Describe one private label product you helped identify, source, launch, improve, or scale. Please mention your exact role in the process.

6.	What makes a product a poor private label launch candidate, even if the sales look strong?

7.	Are you comfortable completing a practical Amazon PL assessment before final hiring?

title: VIDEO EDITOR WANTED — US ECOMMERCE ADS (Remote / Philippines)
description:
???? VIDEO EDITOR WANTED — US META ADS — REMOTE (Philippines)

You edit the ads. We run them. You earn every time they spend.

We're a US ecommerce brand scaling hard on Meta. We test a high volume of ad creatives every single week and we're looking for a video editor who wants to grow with us — and get paid when the work performs.



THE OPPORTUNITY

This isn't just a fixed rate editing job.

We pay a $50 performance bonus for every $1,000 spent on ads you edited.

That means if you edit an ad that spends $10,000 — you earn an extra $500. On top of your base rate.

We're already spending consistently and scaling fast. The editors who do great work here make significantly more than their base rate every single month.

If you know how to make ads that stop the scroll and drive sales — this role will pay you like it.



WHAT YOU'LL BE EDITING



AI voiceover ads (30–65 seconds)

Text on screen / POV format ads (15–20 seconds)

Talking head ads with green screen + b-roll backgrounds

TikTok comment style ads

Static creatives

Competitor footage cut into original ad concepts



Everything comes with a detailed brief — hook, b-roll sequence, voiceover script, text overlays, timing notes. Your job is to execute it cleanly and fast.



WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR

? Experience editing Meta ads specifically — not general video content



? You understand hooks, scroll-stopping cuts and direct response pacing



? Experience with US ecommerce or DTC brands



? Comfortable working with AI voiceover, b-roll and green screen footage



? Fast turnaround — we move quickly and test constantly



? Precise with subtitles, text overlays and timing



? Proactive — you flag problems and suggest improvements



WHO THIS IS NOT FOR

? Editors who only have wedding, travel or lifestyle content in their portfolio



? Editors who can't show ads that actually ran on Meta



? Editors who need hand-holding on every edit



? Editors who take 5+ days per ad



HOW TO APPLY

We get a lot of applications. The only ones we respond to are the ones that prove the work.

To be considered you must send all four of the following:

1. Portfolio



Minimum 3 Meta ads you have edited for ecommerce or DTC brands. Show us the actual finished ads — not raw footage, not general reels.

2. Ad spend proof



Screenshots fro
ta Ads Manager showing spend on ads you edited. We want to see ads that actually ran and spent real money. This is the most important part of your application. No spend proof = no response.

3. Brief breakdown



Pick one ad from your portfolio. In 3–5 sentences tell us: what was the hook trying to do, why did you cut where you cut, what were you trying to achieve with the edit.

4. Your rate + tools



Tell us your base rate per ad or monthly rate, what software you use and your average turnaround time.



WHAT WORKING WITH US LOOKS LIKE

You'll receive Trello briefs for every single ad. Each brief includes the full script, hook direction, b-roll sequence, text on screen lines and timing notes. Everything is mapped out — you bring it to life.

We care about performance over aesthetics. A raw-looking ad that converts beats a beautiful ad that doesn't every single time.

This is a long-term role. We're building a content team and we reward people who grow with us. The editors who perform get more volume, more responsibility and more performance bonuses.





Performance bonus: $50 for every $1,000 spent on ads you edited

There is no cap on performance bonuses. If your ads spend,  you earn.

title: Communication Coach: Senior Professionals (1:1, Remote)
description:
We work with experienced professionals who operate in English in high-pressure international settings: interviews, presentations, senior stakeholder meetings, the 
nts where how clearly you come across genuinely matters.

This is not a teaching role. There is no curriculum and no grammar lessons. You will be running live, high-pressure practice scenarios and reading how a capable person performs under that pressure, then helping them sharpen it. Think closer to improv meets interview preparation than to a classroom.



The best person for this is a strong performer who reads people well in real time. You can play a role convincingly, apply pressure at the right 
nt, notice what is actually happening when someone is put on the spot, and steer a conversation that takes an unexpected turn. You hold your nerve in a silence rather than rushing to fill it.



We have a proven method and a tool that guides you through each session in real time, so you are delivering a clear system, not building from scratch. You deliver our method, with our clients.



Backgrounds that tend to fit:



- Acting, improv, or applied theatre, especially anyone who has done corporate or facilitation work

- Debate, public speaking, or Model UN coaching

- Broadcast, presenting, or media training

- Any background where you read a room and steer a live conversation under pressure



What matters:



- You can perform a scenario and stay natural while doing it

- You read people quickly and notice what pressure does to them

- Excellent, natural spoken English

- Comfortable with senior professionals, calm and hard to rattle

- Reliable on timing, treats scheduled sessions as fixed commitments

- Quiet, professional setup for video calls, ideally dual screen set up

- Available during evening hours (roughly 7pm to 11pm PHT, which is evening in Taiwan, Korea and Japan)



The role:



Rate is $14 to $18 per hour, billed by session length. A full hour is $14 to $18, a 45-minute session is around $11 to $14.



A few hours per week to start, with real scope to grow as we expand, including upcoming corporate work. Part-time and freelance.



If this sounds like you, apply with a short note on your relevant experience, your resume, and tell us about one time you had to read a person and steer a difficult or unexpected live conversation. What did you notice, and what did you do?

 marketing

Who We Are Looking For

title: Operations & Accounting Specialist
description:
Job Posting: Operations & Accounting Specialist



Role Overview



We are looking for a meticulous, organized, and reliable Operations & Accounting Specialist to join our team. In this role, you will handle the vital day-to-day data entry that keeps our business running smoothly—from processing customer orders to ensuring our financial records are accurate and perform month-end close financial activities.



If you have a sharp eye for detail, a knack for numbers, and love bringing structure to data, we want to hear from you.



Key Responsibilities

1. Order Processing & Data Entry



Accurately enter, verify, and process incoming customer orders into our ERP/accounting system.



Maintain and update customer profiles, billing information, and inventory records.





2. Accounting & Month-End Close Support



Assist with daily bookkeeping tasks, including matching invoices to purchase orders and processing accounts payable/receivable data.



Perform bank reconciliations and verify credit card statements against internal receipts.



Prepare and organize financial data, journals, and ledger entries specifically for month-end close deadlines.



Review data for errors, missing information, or inconsistencies.



3. Administrative Maintenance



Maintain digital filing systems for all financial and order records to ensure compliance and easy retrieval.



Generate routine weekly or monthly summary reports for management.



Qualifications & Skills

Experience: 1–3 years of experience in data entry, order management, or a junior bookkeeping/accounting role.



Education: Associate’s or Bachelor’s degree in Accounting, Finance, or Business Administration



Software Proficiency:



Strong proficiency in Microsoft Excel (VLOOKUPs, pivot tables, basic formulas).



Experience with accounting software (e.g., QuickBooks) or ERP systems is highly preferred.



Key Traits:



High Attention to Detail: You catch typos and numerical errors that others miss.



Time Management: Ability to prioritize tasks and meet strict deadlines.



Trustworthiness: High level of integrity when handling sensitive financial data.

nt.

- All inbound customer support across multiple brands, from one unified inbox (Missive).

- End-to-end resolution of order issues: refunds, cancellations, address changes, missing items, shipping delays, promo/BOGO confusion, billing questions.

- Managing orders in WooCommerce and our custom back-office dashboard (holding orders, editing addresses, building replacement/draft orders, issuing refunds, creating gift codes).

- Coordinating with our fulfillment warehouse and payments team to get issues solved fast.

- Protecting revenue (solving the problem and saving the sale instead of always defaulting to refunds).

- Turning recurring issues into clean SOPs and systems so they scale.

- Over time: helping us hire, train, and lead more support reps as we grow. This role has a clear path to Support Manager.



WHO YOU ARE:

- 3+ years in customer support, ideally e-commerce and US customers.

- Native-level WRITTEN English. Warm, clear, concise — a helpful human, not a corporate robot.

- A genuine problem-solver with real judgment. You can read a messy, emotional situation and find the right outcome without a script.

- Independent. You don't need hand-holding. You make the call and own the result.

- Fast. You resolve tickets in minutes, not half an hour each, because your logic and reasoning are sharp.

- Business-minded. You think like an owner d
 what's best for the company, not a button-pusher trying to make the customer go away.

- Tech-comfortable. You pick up tools like Missive, WooCommerce, and internal dashboards quickly.



WHO SHOULD NOT APPLY:

We're being direct to save us both time:

- If you need someone to tell you exactly what to do every day — this isn't for you.

- If your instinct with an upset customer is "just refund them" — this isn't for you.

- If you've only ever followed scripts and never owned outcomes — this isn't for you.

- If your written English isn't near-native — this isn't for you.

- If you're juggling several other clients and want one more on the side — this isn't for you. We want focus and ownership.



HOURS, PAY & GROWTH:

- Full-time, long-term, work-from-home.

- HOURS: Daytime shift, Philippine time, with a few hours of overlap with US business hours.

- SALARY: $500-1,000/month depending on experience, plus a performance bonus.

- Raises and a real path to Support Manager as we grow.

- We pay above market on purpose: we'd rather pay more for someone we can fully trust than save money and have to micromanage.



HOW TO APPLY — READ CAREFULLY (this is the first test):

This job is about following details and reading carefully, so the application is too.

1. Do NOT reply here on onlinejobs.ph. Messages sent here will not be read.

2. Apply ONLY through this form: 

3. The form's first question asks for a secret phrase. The phrase is: SOLVE, DON'T REFUND (We use this to find the people who actually read to the end.)



Applications that skip these steps are automatically declined. Not to be strict for its own sake, but because this is exactly the kind of attention to detail the job requires every single day.



We read every complete application. We're excited to meet the right person.

title: Part-Time SEO & Web Developer (Virtual Assistant)
description:
About us



Buildtonic is a UK construction company that restores and refurbishes period and high-value homes. We want homeowners searching for renovation help to find us — which means a faster, better-built website that ranks. This is a hands-on technical role: you'll own our search visibility and the code behind the site, and you'll use AI tools to move fast. We work to clear SOPs (documented in Notion) with the Director signing off at key gates, so you're trusted to ship — not just take orders.



What you'll do





Technical SEO: Audit and fix what's holding us back — site speed, Core Web Vitals, crawlability, indexing, schema/structured data, internal linking, metadata, and mobile performance. Get the technical foundations right so our content can rank.

Website back-end & code: Work directly in the site's codebase — build and improve pages, templates, and components; fix bugs; tidy and refactor; and keep the back end fast, secure, and maintainable. Implement changes cleanly and test before they go live.

AI-assisted delivery: Use AI coding and SEO tools (e.g. ChatGPT/Claude, Copilot, Cursor, AI keyword/content tools) to work faster and smarter — generating, reviewing, and refining code and content, and automating the repetitive parts. We want someone who gets real leverage from these tools, not someone who pastes output blindly.

On-page & content SEO: Keyword research, on-page optimisation, and SEO-led content/landing pages that target what homeowners actually search for.

Reporting: A simple weekly view of the numbers that matter — rankings, organic traffic, site speed, and what you shipped — so we can see progress.





What we're looking for





2+ years in technical SEO and/or web development

Comfortable working hands-on in a website codebase — HTML, CSS, JavaScript, and a back-end stack (e.g. PHP/WordPress, or a modern JS framework)

Strong technical SEO: Core Web Vitals, structured data, indexing, site architecture, and fixing the issues an audit turns up

Fluent with AI coding and SEO tools and able to show how you use them to ship faster without breaking things

Confident with Google Search Console, Google Analytics, and an SEO suite (Ahrefs, SEMrush, Screaming Frog, or similar)

Careful and methodical — you test changes, you don't push risky code to a live site

Good written English and able to report clearly on what you've done and why

Reliable internet and a quiet space to work with some overlap to UK hours





Nice to have





Experience with our website platform (tell us what you've worked on)

Page-speed/Core Web Vitals optimisation track record with before/after numbers

Exposure to construction, property, architecture, or other high-value service businesses

Light design (Canva) or experience with HubSpot / Notion





How to apply



Please send:





A short note on why you're a good fit (2–3 sentences)

One example of a site you improved — ideally with before/after numbers (rankings, traffic, or page speed) and what you actually changed in the code

The AI tools, SEO tools, and tech stack you're confident with

Your available weekly hours and timezone (and your overlap with UK hours)





Application tip: Start your message with the word "Cornerstone" so we know you read the full ad.

title: Technical Onboarding Manager (Customer Success & Tech Support) - $900 Base + Performance Bonuses
description:
JOB OVERVIEW



We are hiring a Technical Onboarding Manager (TOM) to ensure every new client has a smooth, structured first 48 hours inside our program.



You are the bridge between purchase and success. Your job is to eliminate confusion, solve tech issues, and prepare clients so their 1:1 Coach can focus purely on strategy.



This is a high-accountability, client-facing role. Energy, clarity, authority, and reliability are non-negotiable.



Most of our clients are 45+ years old and many are not tech-savvy. You must stay calm, patient, and fully in control of every call.



BENEFITS



- $900/month guaranteed base (USD)

- Up to $200/month in performance bonuses based directly on your Call Customer Satisfaction (CSAT) and Coach Quality scores.

- Up to $1,400/month total earnings

- Fully remote long-term position

- Clear scorecard and monthly performance reviews

- Structured training on Activation SOP, CRM workflows, and handoff systems

- Career path to Senior TOM, Lead TOM, or Client Success Manager

- 3,600+ clients served since 2019



SCHEDULE



- Full-time, 8 hours per day

- You will be assigned to a fixed 8-hour shift within our main coverage hours: Americas Shift (9 AM–6 PM ET) or APAC Shift (6 PM–2 AM ET).

- Must attend required tea
etings, usually 3pm CET (9 PM PH Time).

- Your schedule must be sustainable long term



RESPONSIBILITIES



- Run structured Activation Calls

- Fully activate every client within 48 hours

- Ensure clients access Kajabi, Slack, AI tools, and all support channels

- Assign the correct 1:1 Coach based on phase, fluency, timezone, availability, and fit

- Build authority for the assigned Coach

- Book Kickoff Calls same day or next day

- Ensure zero no-shows for Kickoff Calls

- Prevent avoidable technical escalations

- Update CRM immediately after each call

- Send clean, structured handoff summaries

- Maintain 24-hour response time in #tech-support (excluding weekends)

- Own the public #tech-support channel; record quick, clear Loom videos to solve ongoing client roadblocks.

- Onboard 20–25 clients per week

- Protect Activation Call calendar capacity

- Eliminate repeated client-facing process errors

- Main goal: Zero confusion for the client. Zero surprises for the Coach.



CORE PERFORMANCE STANDARDS



- 100% of clients activated within 48 hours

- CSAT average 85% or higher

- Zero Kickoff Call no-shows

- 100% CRM accuracy and immediate handoffs

- Accurate calendar management

- Professional, structured communication at all times

- Clear, professional spoken English



REQUIREMENTS



- Strong onboarding or customer support background

- C1-level English or higher

- Calm presence with older or low-tech clients

- Strong judgment under pressure

- Ability to repeat instructions clearly without frustration

- Follows systems and processes without shortcuts

- Advanced Slack usage

- Comfortable with Kajabi, Google Drive, and Zoom troubleshooting

- Willing to learn basic creator tools

- Strong schedule reliability

- Stable high-speed internet with backup connection

- Professional camera, lighting, and background



WE ARE NOT A FIT IF:



- You have a low-energy or hesitant delivery

- You get flustered when non-tech clients get confused

- You struggle to explain technical platforms in simple, everyday language



IDEAL CANDIDATE



- Has handled high-ticket clients

- Explains tech in simple language

- Guides overwhelmed clients step by step

- Protects Coaches from preventable issues

- Organized and detail-focused

- Takes ownership of outcomes

- Wants long-term stability and growth



HOW TO APPLY



Fill in the application form: 
/to/nI8lIXV4



Important note: In the Name field, write: “TOM” + Your First and Last Name.



Only shortlisted candidates will be contacted.



P.S. Once hired, you will be contracted under Social Influence Consulting LLC.

title: Sales/Cold Calling VA - property company
description:
We are looking for a Sales Virtual Assistant to support a growing property company with lead follow-up, appointment booking, CRM updates, and client communication.



This role is ideal for someone who is confident speaking to people, organised, quick to respond, and comfortable handling property-related enquiries in a professional way.



Role Overview



As a Sales VA, your main responsibility is to help turn new enquiries into booked calls, viewings, or qualified opportunities. You will be the first point of contact for many leads, so your communication needs to be clear, polite, confident, and persistent without being pushy.



You will work closely with the sales/property team to make sure every lead is followed up properly, logged correctly, and moved through the pipeline.



Key Responsibilities

- Lead Follow-Up

- Respond to new leads from
, website forms, WhatsApp,
, property portals, and CRM systems.

- Call, message, and
 leads quickly after they enquire.

- Follow up with old leads who have not replied.

- Keep leads warm through polite and consistent communication.



Qualification

- Ask basic qualifying questions to understand the lead’s needs.

- Find out their property requirements, budget, location, timeline, and level of interest.

- Identify serious leads and pass them to the right tea
mber.

- Filter out low-quality or unsuitable enquiries.



Appointment Booking

- Book calls, viewings, consultations, or meetings into the team calendar.

- Confirm appointments with leads.

- Send reminders before appointments.

- Follow up with leads who miss calls or do not attend booked meetings.



CRM Management

- Add new leads into the CRM.

- Update contact details, notes, lead status, and follow-up dates.

- Make sure no lead is left without a next step.

- Keep the sales pipeline clean and organised.



Communication Support

- Send professional messages to leads, tenants, landlords, investors, or clients.

- Use approved scripts and templates while still sounding natural.

- Escalate important questions or difficult situations to the sales/property team.

- Maintain a professional tone at all times.



Requirements



The ideal candidate should have:

- Strong spoken and written English with a direct tone.

- Previous experience in sales, appointment setting, customer service, or admin.

- Confidence making calls and speaking to new people.

- Good organisation and attention to detail.

- Ability to follow scripts, processes, and CRM instructions.

- Fast response time and strong follow-up habits.

- A reliable internet connection and quiet working environment.

- Experience in property, real estate, lettings, estate agency, or property management is preferred but not required.



Tools You May Use:

CRM system (GHL).

WhatsApp.

.

Google Calendar.

Google Sheets.

/Meta lead forms.

Property management or sales platforms.





Personality Fit

We are looking for someone who is:

Confident.

Reliable.

Proactive.

Friendly but professional.

Comfortable with rejection.

Good at following up.

Organised.

Direct when needed.

Willing to learn the property industry.



Working Hours:

UK business hours preferred, usually around 9:00 AM to 5:00 PM UK time, depending on the company’s needs.

title: Paid Advertising Manager for European Ecommerce Company
description:
Paid Advertising Manage for European Ecommerce Company



EM Digital Group AS is a Norwegian ecommerce company operating multiple online stores across Europe. We specialize in software, digital licenses, and games, and we are growing our portfolio of brands in several markets.



Some of the brands we operate include:







Licenshuset.dk





Domlicencji.pl



We are now looking for an experienced Paid Advertising Specialist / PPC Expert to join our team and help us grow our paid advertising across multiple websites and markets.



This is a long-term remote position for someone who is analytical, structured, proactive, and experienced with performance marketing.



Your role



You will be responsible for managing, optimizing, and scaling paid advertising campaigns for several ecommerce websites in different European countries.



Your main focus will be Google Ads, but experience with Meta Ads, Microsoft Ads, TikTok Ads, or other paid channels is also a plus.



You will work closely with our team to improve campaign performance, increase revenue, reduce wasted ad spend, and help us find new growth opportunities.



To succeed in the position you will need to be able to take ownership of the PPC campagins, and work independent. 



Main responsibilities

Manage and optimize Google Ads campaigns across multiple ecommerce websites

Work with Search, Shopping, Performance Max, Display, and remarketing campaigns

Analyze campaign performance and make data-driven decisions

Improve ROAS, conversion rate, CPC, CPA, and overall profitability

Create and test new campaign structures, keywords, audiences, and ad copy

Monitor daily performance and identify issues or opportunities quickly

Perform keyword research and competitor research

Set up and improve conversion tracking 

Prepare clear reports with insights, actions taken, and recommendations

Help scale paid advertising profitably across several European markets

Work together with our internal team on landing pages, offers, pricing, and product performance

Retargeting with Meta Ads



Requirements



We are looking for someone who has:



Strong experience with Google Ads (Minimum 3 years)

Experience managing ecommerce PPC campaigns (Minimum 3 years)

Good understanding of ROAS, CPA, CPC, CTR, conversion rate, and profit-based advertising

Experience with Google Shopping and/or Performance Max

Ability to analyze data and explain what should be improved

Experience with Google Analytics 4

Experience with Google Tag Manager

Good English communication skills

Ability to work independently and take ownership of results

Stable internet connection and a reliable remote work setup



Nice to have



These are not required, but they are a big plus:



Experience with Meta Ads

Experience with Microsoft Ads

Experience with ecommerce platforms like WooCommerce or Shopify

Experience advertising in multiple countries or languages

Experience with software, digital products, licenses, or gaming products

Basic understanding of SEO and conversion rate optimization



Who we are looking for



We are not looking for someone who only follows instructions.



We are looking for someone who can think, analyze, and suggest better ways to grow. You should be comfortable looking at campaign data, finding problems, testing improvements, and explaining your recommendations clearly.



The right person is someone who cares about results and wants to become an important part of a growing ecommerce company.



Work setup

Remote position

Long-term opportunity

Part-time or full-time depending on experience and availability

Flexible working hours, but you must be available for regular communication with the team

Bonuses based on performance



How to apply



Please apply with the following information:



A short introduction about yourself

Your experience with Google Ads and ecommerce PPC

Examples of campaigns or results you have worked on, if available

Which ad platforms you have experience with

Your hourly rate 

Your current availability



To make sure you have read the full job post, please include the word “EMDG” in the first line of your application.



We are looking for someone reliable, skilled, and motivated to help us grow our paid advertising across Europe.



We look forward to hearing from you.

title: Creative Video Editor for Social Media Agency Campaign
description:

title: Video Enhancement & Upscaling Specialist
description:
About Us



Tashi Non-Stop is a children's educational platform for kids ages 4 to 7. We create movement-based, character-driven learning experiences that are engaging, sensory-rich, and designed to support all learners, especially neurodiverse children. Our courses combine music, storytelling, and physical activity to make learning active, meaningful, and fun.



We're currently preparing a curated video feature called the Super Secret Cinema Club and are looking to enhance our existing video library to a consistent, high-quality standard.



The Project



We have a collection of short videos ranging from 45 seconds to 2 minutes and 30 seconds in length. Some of these videos were created at lower resolutions or have inconsistent visual and audio quality.



We're looking for a Video Enhancement & Upscaling Specialist to improve the quality of these videos while preserving their original look and feel. This is a technical enhancement role, not a creative editing role. No re-editing or story changes are required. The focus is on upscaling, visual cleanup, audio enhancement, and creating a consistent viewing experience across all videos.



What You’ll Do



- AI Upscaling: Upscale low-resolution videos to a minimum of 1080p using advanced AI upscaling tools.

- Visual Cleanup: Apply noise reduction, targeted sharpening, and stabilization to improve visual clarity without introducing noticeable AI artifacts.

- Color & Contrast: Correct brightness, contrast, and color balance. Light enhancement of warmth and vibrancy is welcome. The final result should feel inviting, natural, and consistent across all videos.

- Audio Enhancement: Clean up audio where needed by reducing hiss and background noise, balancing dialogue levels, and improving clarity.

- Delivery: Export optimized files in MP4 format at appropriate bitrates. Files should be clearly named and organized.

- Settings Summary: Provide a brief settings summary for each video, including the software used, enhancement settings, output resolution, and codec.



Requirements



- Software: Experience using Topaz Video AI, DaVinci Resolve Super Scale, or similar AI video enhancement and upscaling tools.

- Technical Knowledge: Understanding of video codecs, bitrates, frame rates, and export settings.

- Restoration Skills: Ability to apply color correction, noise reduction, and other enhancements while maintaining a natural look and preserving the original feel of the video.

- Hardware: Must have the equipment and computing power needed to process AI video enhancement and upscaling efficiently and deliver the project within the agreed timeline.

- Reliability: Clear communication and dependable turnaround on a small, defined project.

- Required: Must provide a before-and-after sample demonstrating upscaling or enhancement results.



How to Apply



Please send your application to 
 with the following:



In your
, include:

- The specific AI tools and software you use.

- Your GPU model and basic hardware specs.

- Your estimated turnaround time for a batch of 10 short videos.

- Your rate per minute of footage processed or per video.



Also attach your resume or portfolio, along with a before-and-after video sample showing your upscaling or enhancement work.



Applications must include a before-and-after sample. Applications without samples will not be considered.

title: DTC Creative Strategist (Paid Ad Creative + AI UGC) — Multiple Brands
description:
I'm looking for a creative strategist with a strong DTC ecommerce / affiliate background to own ad creative strategy across several of my businesses. You'll develop the creative — hooks, angles, personas, scripts, concepts — that I push as paid ads (primarily Meta, expanding to other channels over time). 



I handle the media buying myself; I need someone who thinks in creative that converts, not creative that just looks pretty.This is a strategy-first role. Your job is to tell me what to make and why it will perform, grounded in direct-response thinking and creative testing.You'll create strategy across these businesses:

- Real estate — high-ticket property, international buyers. Trust-building, qualified lead generation.

- High-ticket digital product — a personal brand offer plus a B2B product. Direct-response, lead-gen focused.

- Wellness retreat — consumer-facing, experience-driven, aspirational creative aimed at bookings.

- Ecommerce DTC brand — straight consumer DTC, the category you'll likely know best.



These are very different audiences and price points, so I need someone who adjusts angle and tone per brand rather than running one playbook across all of them.



AI UGC experience is required:



A big part of this role is shipping a high volume of creative quickly and cost-efficiently. You need hands-on experience producing AI UGC — both to generate volume and because certain formats are faster and cheaper to ship with AI than by hiring real UGC creators for every concept. Please include AI-generated creative you've actually produced when you apply.



What you'll do:



- Build paid ad creative strategy per brand: hooks, angles, personas, scripts, storyboards, ad concepts.

- Produce a high volume of creative efficiently, using AI UGC where it's the faster/cheaper path.

- Run creative testing — propose what to test, read results, turn data into the next round.

- Adapt messaging across different audiences and funnel stages.



You're a strong fit if you have:



- Proven DTC ecommerce / affiliate creative strategy experience (not branding-only).

- A portfolio of paid-social creative with performance context (CTR, CPA, ROAS, hook rate).

- Hands-on AI UGC experience.

- Strong grasp of direct-response fundamentals (hooks, angles, AIDA, problem-solution, unique mechanism).

- Excellent written English.



To apply, please send:



1. 2–3 examples of paid ad creative you've worked on, with performance numbers if you have them.

2. At least one example of AI-generated UGC you've produced (tool used + the output).

3. A few sentences on how you'd approach the differences in creative strategy across these audiences — property buyers vs. high-ticket digital buyers vs. wellness consumers vs. DTC shoppers. I want to see how you think, not a templated proposal.



Applications without an AI UGC sample or that don't address the multi-audience question won't be reviewed.

title: Amazon FBA Wholesale Product Research, Sourcing and Supplier Operations Specialist
description:
Position: Amazon FBA Wholesale Product Research, Sourcing & Supplier Operations Specialist

Type: Full-Time, Remote (Philippines)

Salary: PHP 25,000 - 45,000 / month, depending on experience

Schedule: Full-time PH daytime hours, with flexibility for supplier, distributor, and Amazon-related communication



About our Company



We are a Canadian corporation specialized in international trade, wholesale, and e-commerce. We are building Amazon wholesale and private label operations in Canada and the United States, with a focus on long-term supplier relationships, organized execution, and data-driven decision-making. Our company values professionalism, clear communication, and practical execution. We are establishing a strong, world-class team in the Philippines.



Role Overview



We are seeking an Amazon FBA Wholesale Product Research, Sourcing & Supplier Operations Specialist to execute and manage key parts of our Amazon wholesale workflow across Canada and the United States. This role combines Amazon wholesale product research, supplier sourcing, distributor and brand outreach, account applications, onboarding, follow-ups, and daily workflow execution.



This is a main execution role, not a passive support role. The main purpose is to find and validate viable Amazon wholesale opportunities, build and manage the supplier pipeline, keep supplier and product files organized, and move the workflow forward without constant supervision.

The exact focus may shift depending on business priorities, supplier responses, available catalogs, and current workflow bottlenecks.



NOTE: General VA, Shopify, dropshipping, social media, customer service, or basic admin experience alone is not suitable for this role. Candidates must have direct Amazon product research, Amazon wholesale, supplier sourcing, supplier communication, or Amazon operations experience.



Key Responsibilities:



• Conduct Amazon wholesale product research using Amazon, Keepa, SellerAmp, Seller Central, Google Sheets, and other available Amazon research tools.

• Evaluate product demand, pricing, Buy Box behavior, FBA competition, seller count, Amazon presence, reviews, sales rank, gating status, brand restrictions, and estimated profitability.

• Screen supplier catalogs, wholesale price lists, brand search results, distributor product lists, and product files to identify viable Amazon wholesale opportunities.

• Research and identify potential wholesale distributors, brands, manufacturers, and suppliers in Canada and the United States.

• Contact suppliers, distributors, and brands by
 or web form and follow up professionally.

• Complete wholesale account applications, supplier forms, distributor onboarding forms, and account setup documents.

• Request and organize wholesale pricing, catalogs, MOQ, case pack details, stock availability, lead times, shipping terms, payment terms, and account requirements.

• Confirm whether suppliers allow Amazon, FBA, online marketplace sales, reseller accounts, or require written marketplace approval.

• Maintain supplier trackers, distributor trackers, application status sheets, outreach logs, product screening files, and follow-up lists.

• Organize supplier folders, application screenshots, pricing lists, catalog files, account notes, product research notes, and communication records in Google Drive.

• Coordinate with prep centers, suppliers, distributors, and internal tea
mbers when needed.

• Use AI tools to draft, organize, summarize, and check work, while carefully verifying accuracy.

• Prepare clear daily updates showing completed work, links, blockers, risks, and next steps.

• Flag supplier issues, application blockers, missing documents, marketplace restrictions, pricing problems, weak products, poor-fit suppliers, or workflow delays early.

• Support both Amazon Canada and Amazon US wholesale workflows as the business expands.



Qualifications:



• 2-4 years of direct Amazon FBA wholesale experience required, including Amazon product research, wholesale product screening, supplier sourcing, distributor outreach, brand outreach, Amazon operations, and wholesale account setup.

• Hands-on experience with Amazon Seller Central, Keepa, SellerAmp, Google Sheets, Google Drive, Gmail, supplier catalogs, wholesale price lists, and distributor application workflows required.

• Strong understanding of wholesale product viability, including demand, pricing, competition, Buy Box, seller count, Amazon presence, fees, profitability, gating, and brand restrictions.

• Strong written English and professional supplier communication skills.

• Highly organized and able to manage multiple product research tasks, supplier conversations, applications, files, follow-ups, and status trackers at the same time.

• Comfortable following SOPs, checklists, templates, company instructions, policies, and structured workflows.

• Strong attention to detail with product data, pricing, supplier information, application forms, account requirements, and status tracking.

• Able to work independently, take ownership of tasks, and keep work moving without constant supervision.

• Comfortable asking clear questions, reporting blockers early, and providing practical updates.

• Must be comfortable with both Amazon product research and supplier-side communication, not only one side of the workflow.

• Must be reliable, responsive, and consistent with daily execution.

• Must be up-to-date with AI tools and actively use them to improve research quality, analysis, judgment, decision-making, and workflow speed.



KPIs / Success Measures:



• Quality and accuracy of Amazon wholesale product research and screening decisions.

• Ability to identify viable wholesale opportunities and reject weak products or poor-fit suppliers quickly.

• Number and quality of relevant suppliers, distributors, brands, catalogs, and product opportunities researched.

• Quality and consistency of supplier, distributor, and brand outreach.

• Accuracy and completeness of wholesale applications, onboarding files, supplier records, and product research files.

• Speed and quality of follow-ups without losing professionalism or accuracy.

• Organization of Google Drive folders, trackers, supplier records, product screening files, and daily work files.

• Ability to identify supplier restrictions, Amazon marketplace issues, gating issues, application blockers, pricing issues, and workflow risks early.

• Low error rate in forms, supplier details, pricing data, product information, and tracking sheets.

• Clear communication of completed work, blockers, risks, action items, and next steps.

• Ability to take ownership of the wholesale workflow and improve execution over time.

• Consistent ability to follow company instructions, SOPs, policies, and communication standards.



What We Offer:



• Full-time remote/hybrid work opportunity with a Canadian company.

• Long-term opportunity as the Amazon wholesale business grows.

• Structured SOPs, templates, and workflow support.

• Direct communication with company management.

• Opportunity to work across Amazon product research, wholesale sourcing, supplier operations, and marketplace expansion.

• Opportunity to grow into a more senior role as the business reaches revenue and expands.

• Performance-based growth opportunities.

title: Sales Manager
description:
JVDB Studios | Amsterdam, Netherlands



Location: Remote (Philippines)

Schedule: Monday to Friday

Hours: 20 hours per week to start (Part-Time) with the opportunity to scale to 40 hours per week based on performance

Time Zone: Must have overlap with European/CET business hours

Compensation: Competitive base salary + uncapped commission



About JVDB Studios



JVDB Studios is a media and technology company based in Amsterdam, Netherlands. We are the team behind some of the world's largest creator brands, including Kwebbelkop and BlooGaming, which collectively reach more than 15 million subscribers globally.



Our CEO has built multiple successful digital businesses, generated billions of views across platforms, and continues to expand into new ventures within content, technology, licensing, and media distribution.



We are looking for a highly driven Senior Sales Manager / Commercial Lead who can take ownership of revenue-generating relationships across the business and work directly with the CEO to drive growth.



The Opportunity



This is not a traditional sales role. We are looking for a proven closer who can build opportunities from scratch, develop relationships with decision-makers, and personally close deals.



You will own the full sales cycle across multiple business lines and play a key role in helping scale the company internationally. This role begins as a part-time position at 20 hours per week. Candidates who demonstrate strong execution, ownership, and the ability to consistently generate and close opportunities will have the opportunity to transition into a full-time role at 40 hours per week.



We believe in rewarding results. As you help grow the business, the role will grow alongside you.



What You'll Be Responsible For



You will own all revenue-generating relationships across the group, including brand partnerships, media licensing opportunities, FAST and OTT distribution partnerships, DubDash new business development, and creator service partnerships.



You will be responsible for building and managing your own pipeline, conducting outbound prospecting, qualifying opportunities, leading discovery and sales calls, creating proposals, negotiating commercial terms, closing deals, and ensuring a smooth handoff to operations. You will also maintain CRM accuracy, provide regular reporting, forecast revenue, and proactively identify risks and opportunities.



This position reports directly to the CEO with a dotted reporting line to the COO.



What We're Looking For



We are seeking someone with at least four years of B2B sales or business development experience and a demonstrated personal track record of closing consultative, multi-week sales opportunities. You should be able to show real numbers and revenue results from deals you have personally closed.



You must be comfortable owning the full sales cycle from prospecting to close and be confident communicating with senior decision-makers across Europe, the United States, and the Middle East. Near-native business English, both written and verbal, is essential for this role.



The ideal candidate is highly organized, self-motivated, accountable, and capable of building systems and opportunities from scratch. We are looking for a self-starter who can operate independently while maintaining strong communication with leadership.



Candidates with experience in SaaS, media, creator economy businesses, content licensing, FAST channels, OTT distribution, or high-ticket B2B services will be viewed favorably, although these are not required.



This Role Is Not For You If



Your recent career has focused primarily on managing sales teams instead of personally closing deals. You have experience only in appointment setting or SDR roles without a proven closing record. You rely on company logos or network connections rather than demonstrated sales performance. You require a fully built-out system, extensive support, or a large team in order to succeed.



Why Join JVDB Studios



This is a unique opportunity to work directly with a founder who has built audiences of more than 15 million subscribers and multiple successful digital businesses. You will have direct access to leadership, exposure to international clients and partnerships, and the opportunity to play a key role in shaping the commercial future of a rapidly growing media company.



You will work in a fully remote environment with a Monday-to-Friday schedule and collaborate with partners and clients across Europe, North America, and the Middle East. The role offers uncapped commission potential and a clear path from a part-time position into a full-time opportunity for individuals who consistently deliver results.



How to Apply



Subject Line: JVDB Sales Manager



Send your updated resume along with a short Loom video introducing yourself and discussing your sales experience. In your video, please share examples of deals you have personally closed, the types of clients you have worked with, and any sales metrics or achievements you are proud of.



Please send your application to:







Only candidates with a proven track record of personally closing deals will be considered.

--- What you'll be editing ---



A mix of short-form video styles, including:

- Voiceover vlog-style content

- B-roll with trendy text overlays and trending audio — fast-paced, social-native edits



You will always be given:



- The full script

- The hook (text + notes on delivery/style)

- A reference Loom fro
 showing my exact editing style, pacing, and examples for each content type



You won't be guessing at what I want — I'll show you exactly what "good" looks like before you start.

- Comfortable with trendy captions/text animations and syncing to trending audio

- Can follow a style guide closely and ask good questions when something's unclear

- Ongoing role: Part-time to start (about 25-30 hrs/month based on current volume of 20 videos/client/month), with the rate at about $500/client/month

- Growth potential: As I sign new clients, your hours and pay grow right along with the business — this won't stay capped at 20 videos/month if things keep scaling.

- Long-term potential to grow into more hours/full-time as the agency grows.



--- How to apply ---

- The software you edit in

- Your availability (hours/week)

Looking forward to finding the right long-term fit — not just a one-off editor.

title: AI-Native Video Editor | DTC Paid Social Ads
description:
Got the Evolve format. Real talk before I write it: your draft has one contradiction that'll bite you. You say "you don't need to be the finished article" then say "experience is essential." That softness invites underqualified applicants. At 50 concepts/month + $2-3K, you can't afford to train someone from zero. So I'm tightening that.



Also baking in your real filter (Loom video + actual proof, no NDA excuses) because that's what separates editors who've actually shipped ads from portfolio cosplayers.



Here it is:



---



**VIDEO EDITOR — PAID SOCIAL ADS (DTC SUPPLEMENTS)**



We're hiring a video editor to work on paid social ads for one of our DTC supplement brands doing serious volume.



This is not a "stitch clips together" role. We're looking for someone who thinks like a marketer first, editor second. If you've only edited YouTube vlogs, wedding videos, or "aesthetic" reels, this isn't for you.



**THE ROLE**



You'll work directly under a creative strategist who gives you scripts, briefs, and direction. Your job is to execute those concepts at a level where the ad actually sells. The bar is not "looks clean." The bar is "stops the scroll, holds the viewer for 30+ seconds, and drives the click."



You'll also bring your own ad concepts to the table. If your concept goes live and performs, you get a bonus on every winning concept you originate. Editors who think like strategists will print money in this role.



**VOLUME EXPECTATIONS (READ CAREFULLY)**



- Minimum 50 ad concepts per month

- Minimum 2 concepts per day

- This is non-negotiable. The only way to hit this is heavy AI tool use. If you're hand-cutting every frame, you'll never hit the number.



If 50/month sounds insane, do not apply. We've already built the system, the briefs are tight, the asset library is deep, and AI does 60% of the heavy lifting. Your job is to execute fast, not perfect every pixel.



**YOU MUST BE FLUENT IN**



- Direct-response video editing for Meta 
 + Instagram ads, not branded content)

- AI tools, practically not theoretically. We use realistic avatars, AI UGC, AI voiceovers, image and video generation, and whatever new tools drop next week. You should already be using Higgsfield, Veo, Sora, Kling, ElevenLabs, HeyGen, Captions, or equivalents daily.

- Hook mechanics, pacing, captions, framing, retention curves

- Building 10-20 variations of a winning ad fast (iteration speed is the whole game)



**WHAT YOU'LL ACTUALLY DO**



- Take scripts and briefs from the creative strategist, deliver finished ads

- Hit 2 concepts/day, 50+ per month

- Build variations of winners (different hooks, different opens, different lengths)

- Pitch your own concepts when you see openings

- Document what works, help build SOPs the team can scale

- Sit in weekly creative reviews and apply feedback to next batch



**HARD REQUIREMENTS**



- Real DTC experience. Not "I edited my friend's clothing brand IG." We mean ads that ran on Meta at spend that mattered.

- Working knowledge of what a hook is, why retention drops at 3 seconds, why a captioned word breaks at the wrong syllable kills a scroll.

- Comfortable working fast. If you need three days to deliver one ad, you're in the wrong job.

- Willing to grow, take feedback without ego, and get better every week.



**DO NOT APPLY IF**



- You can't hit 50 concepts/month

- You've never edited a Meta ad that ran on paid traffic

- You think AI tools are "cheating" or you're "still learning them"

- You need NDA excuses to avoid showing real work

- You only do high-polish brand films and hate volume

- You're slow, precious about your edits, or get defensive on feedback



**PAY**



Starting $2,000-$3,000/month based on demonstrated speed and quality. Plus performance bonuses on every winning concept you originate that goes live and scales.



If you crush this role you'll be making more than the base within 90 days from concept bonuses alone.



**HOW TO APPLY**



Send the following or your application gets ignored:



1. A 3-5 minute Loom walking us through 3-5 ads you actually edited. Show the brand, the spend it ran at, the metrics if you have them (CTR, hold rate, ROAS, anything). Talk through WHY you made the editing choices you made, what hook moves you pulled, how you thought about retention.

2. Links to the ads themselves (Meta Ad Library is fine, ad creative files, anything we can watch).

3. One AI-assisted ad you've made recently. We want to see your AI workflow in action, not just the output.

4. Your daily output ceiling. How many ads can you realistically ship per day at your current pace?



No CV-only applications. No "I can't share work because NDA." Real editors have ways to show their work.



---



Couple of strategic notes on this JD before you post it:



**What this filters well:** Volume requirement scares off slow editors. AI requirement filters traditional editors clinging to manual workflows. Loom + actual ad library requirement filters portfolio cosplayers. The "DO NOT APPLY IF" section does most of the screening before you ever read an application.



**What you might want to add depending on where you post it:**

- Timezone overlap requirement (do you need them online during Bangkok hours or just async delivery?)

- Trial structure (most DTC brands run a 1-2 week paid trial at lower rate before committing to full $2-3K)

- Which brand specifically? Naming Blissta might attract better applicants who've seen your ads. Or you might want to keep it confidential to avoid competitor recon. Your call.



**The bigger question:** This role at $2-3K is the right hire if you want execution capacity. But based on what we've talked about, the actual bottleneck is the gap between finished script and winning ad. An editor at $2-3K can fill execution. They will not fix the gap. The Creative Director hire at $10K still does that. So treat this as a parallel hire that frees up your current editor capacity, not a substitute for the CD seat.

Founded by a serial entrepreneur who has built and scaled multiple ventures, the company is small, fast, and built for the new era of AI enabled search.

This is a hands-on web developer role for someone who does technical SEO the modern way: in the terminal, through SSH, and with Claude Code doing real work alongside you. The strategy is handled. What I need is someone who can get into a client's WordPress site, diagnose what's holding back search and AI visibility, and actually fix it, then keep those systems running without being chased.



You're technically strong, comfortable on the command line, and the kind of person who finishes what they start. You'll execute and improve technical SEO and GEO performance across multiple client sites, and you'll help build the workflows and SOPs that keep everything reproducible as we grow.

You'll work in a modern, AI first stack. We run client activity through Claude as our primary system of record, and we use Claude Code, Claude Cowork, SSH, Notion, GitHub, and WP-CLI to do the actual GEO and SEO work. The one non-negotiable is that you're genuinely open to working differently. If you have already used SSH, you'll feel at home fast.
