Run technical SEO and GEO audits using tools like Screaming Frog, Ahrefs, Google Search Console, and GA4.

Guided by Claude Code and me, you will diagnose and fix crawlability, indexation, page speed, sitemap, schema, and canonicalization issues.

Optimize site structure, internal linking, and Core Web Vitals.

2. Hands-on site work via SSH and Claude Code



Connect to client WordPress sites over SSH and make changes directly using WP-CLI.

Use Claude Code to write, run, and document the scripts and edits that do the actual work.

Implement structured data and schema markup to improve visibility on both search engines and AI answer engines.

3. GEO and AEO support



Support GEO and AEO work, optimizing client visibility on ChatGPT, Gemini, Perplexity, and AI Overviews.

Monitor rankings, traffic, and technical performance, and turn the data into clear summaries and recommendations.

4. Systems and documentation



Execute on-page and technical deliverables for client sites, on time, every time.

Document processes and maintain clean, reproducible workflows and SOPs so the work holds up as the client base grows.

Required experience

Hands-on technical SEO experience (agency or freelance).

Comfortable working over SSH and on the command line; able to operate confidently in a client's server environment.

Experience using Claude Code (or a comparable AI coding tool) to do real development and SEO work, not just experiment.

Strong with the core tools: Ahrefs, Screaming Frog, GA4, Google Search Console.

Solid grasp of HTML, XML sitemaps, 
, and core web technologies.

Comfortable in WordPress, ideally with Divi, and familiar with WP-CLI.

Clear written communication and strong organizational skills.

Reliable and self-managing: you track your own commitments and hit deadlines without reminders.

Nice to have

Experience with GEO/AEO strategy or prompt writing.

Why join

Direct access to the founder. You work with me, not through layers.

A front-row seat to GEO, the next frontier of search visibility.

Real ownership over systems and delivery from day one.

Core values that actually matter here: be kind to one another, be generous, and always be learning.

Remote, flexible schedule.

title: Credit Analyst Australia Mortgage Broker
description:
We are looking for an experienced Australian mortgage credit analyst to join our growing mortgage broking business in a paid, ongoing role.



This is a great opportunity for someone who enjoys analysing deals, comparing lender options and using their credit knowledge to help shape the right lending strategy.



This is not a basic data-entry or processing role. Your focus will be on credit assessment, serviceability, lender policy, product comparison and identifying any missing documents or icredit ssues before an application is submitted.



What you will do



• Assess borrowing capacity and serviceability across multiple lenders using Quickli

• Compare lender products, pricing, policy and overall suitability

• Recommend the strongest lender options based on each client’s circumstances

• Review first home buyer, PAYG and self-employed scenarios

• Identify policy concerns, servicing issues and potential deal-breakers early

• Review supporting documents and identify anything missing or inconsistent

• Provide practical recommendations on how to strengthen or restructure a deal

• Clearly communicate your findings and recommended next steps



What we are looking for



• Strong hands-on experience with Quickli

• Strong knowledge of Australian residential lending policy

• Experience assessing first home buyer, PAYG and self-employed applications

• Confidence comparing lenders and explaining why one option is more suitable than another

• Excellent written English and clear communication skills

• Sharp attention to detail and strong numerical ability

• A proactive, independent thinker who takes ownership of their work



Preferred, but not essential



• BrokerEngine experience

• HubSpot experience

• SMSF lending experience

• Low-doc lending experience

• Broad knowledge across major banks, second-tier lenders and non-bank lenders



SMSF and low-doc experience would be a bonus, but are not essential for the right person.



Why join us?



You will work across a wide range of lending scenarios and play an important role in shaping the lending strategy before a deal is submitted.



We are looking for someone we can build a long-term working relationship with. There will be ongoing work for the right person, and we are prepared to pay well for someone with strong experience, excellent credit knowledge and the ability to deliver high-quality assessments independently.



How to apply



Please start your application with the word “Turnip” so we know you have read the position description in full.



Please include a brief summary of your Australian mortgage credit assessment experience and the lenders whose policies you know best.



Remuneration will reflect your experience, credit knowledge and ability to independently assess and structure lending scenarios.

title: QA Tester / QA Analyst — WordPress/WooCommerce Marketplace (Full-Time, Remote)
description:
We're looking for an experienced QA Tester / QA Analyst to join our team full-time, focused primarily on testing a WordPress + WooCommerce multi-vendor marketplace project — a new layer of marketplace functionality built on top of our existing ecommerce store.

 

While the marketplace is the main priority, this is a full-time role: you'll also help with QA across the website as a whole, picking up other testing needs as they come up. Think of yourself as the QA owner for the whole platform, not just one feature set.

 

This is primarily a manual functional and exploratory QA role. Automation experience is a nice-to-have, not a requirement.

 

WHAT YOU'LL BE DOING

 

You'll review marketplace flows at a high level, verify what's working, find issues, and produce clear QA reports with visual confirmation. Main areas include:

 

• Seller lifecycle: application, approval/rejection, seller roles and permissions

• Marketplace browsing: catalogue/archive pages, offer cards, filters, sorting, pagination, empty/expired states

• Public seller profiles/store pages

• Marketplace offer and image-related flows (where applicable)

• Buyer checkout: behavior involving marketplace offers and warranty options

• Wallet system: pending/available/paid balances, hold periods, withdrawal requests, admin disbursement, ledger history, CSV export, refunds/reversals

• Reviews: submission, editing, moderation/admin review, display, aggregation, notification
s

• Warranty: quote popup, checkout persistence, claim form, admin claim resolution

• Fulfillment/SLA foundation: delivery tier behavior, SLA deadline/order metadata, fulfillment status metadata

• Admin marketplace configuration: per-game config, filter tree, site settings, empty-state/illustration settings

• General QA: cross-browser/mobile checks, console errors, broken layouts, permission issues,
 triggers, basic REST/API behavior

• Beyond the marketplace: supporting QA needs across the rest of the website as they come up

 

REQUIRED EXPERIENCE

 

• Strong manual QA experience

• Ecommerce or marketplace testing experience

• WordPress/WooCommerce experience preferred

• Comfortable testing role-based flows: buyer, seller, admin

• Basic API testing with Postman or similar

• Comfortable using browser DevTools for console/network checks

• Can write clear bug reports: repro steps, expected result, actual result, screenshots/video, browser/device, severity

• Good English communication, written and verbal

• Can produce clean, organized screen recordings to share with the client

 

Automated regression testing experience is a bonus — not required. The immediate need is a strong manual QA tester who can understand business flows deeply, test them carefully end-to-end, and deliver a reliable QA report with clean visual evidence.

 

WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR (PERSONALITY/FIT)

 

• Takes ownership — tests this like it's your own product, not just a checklist of assigned tickets

• Gets things done — we need someone effective, not just someone who's online and "available"

• Proactive — flags risks and gaps, doesn't just wait to be told what to test next

 

BENEFITS

 

• Paid vacation leave after 3 months

• Stable, long-term role with a growing company

 

ROLE DETAILS

 

• Location: Remote (Philippines)

• Working Hours: TBD, quite flexible

• Time Tracking: Required

 

DELIVERABLES YOU'LL OWN

 

• QA test plan/checklist

• Executed test report

• Prioritized/severity-tagged bug list

• Retesting confirmation for fixed issues

• Final QA summary: pass/fail, blockers, risks, and recommendation

• Client-ready visual confirmation package: short videos/screenshots for every flow that can be shown visually

 

On visual evidence: record short, clean videos for key working flows — not just raw bug evidence for internal use. These videos may be used in client presentations, so they need to be organized, understandable, and free of unnecessary debug/admin noise. Developer recordings and PR testing notes can be used as a reference, but you'll verify independently and produce the final client-ready evidence yourself.

 

Videos should be grouped by feature/flow, for example:

• Buyer browsing catalogue/filtering/opening an offer

• Buyer checkout with marketplace offer and warranty option

• Seller application and admin approval/rejection

• Public seller profile/store page

• Wallet summary, ledger, withdrawal request/admin handling

• Review submission/display/admin moderation

• Warranty quote/claim/admin resolution

• Admin marketplace configuration/per-game settings

• Offer/image-related flows (where applicable)

 

HOW TO APPLY

 

Include "MC" in your subject line. Briefly answer the following:

 

1. What's the most complex QA project you've worked on or contributed to (ideally ecommerce/marketplace)?

2. How did you track testing coverage, bugs, or results?

3. What tools or systems did you use to manage test plans, bug tracking, or reporting?

4. Give one example of how you improved a QA process or caught something others missed.

 

Attach your resume and a link to your LinkedIn profile.

 

Applications that do not answer all questions will not be considered.

 

IMPORTANT

 

Do not apply if you don't have hands-on manual QA experience, ideally with ecommerce or marketplace platforms. You must:

 

• Have real experience testing complex, role-based web applications

• Understand how QA workflows operate in practice, not just "click around and report bugs"

• Be capable of owning test planning and reporting, not just executing assigned test cases

 

This is not a training role.

title: TikTok Shop Product Researcher & Video Creator (Dropshipping)
description:
IMPORTANT — READ BEFORE APPLYING



This post has specific application instructions at the bottom. If you do not follow them exactly, your application will not be opened. We receive many applications and use the instructions below to identify candidates who pay attention to detail — which is a core requirement of this role.





About Us



We run a TikTok Shop dropshipping store focused on evergreen, problem-solving products — items that address real consumer needs and can be sold year-round, regardless of season. We are building a serious content and product operation and need someone who can own the full process from finding winning products to getting them in front of millions of people.





What You Will Do



Part 1 — Product Research & Validation



You will identify product opportunities from TikTok Shop, AliExpress, and competitor storefronts. Every product you submit must be backed by a completed Excel validation sheet that includes the following:



Market & Demand Signals





TikTok search volume and relevant hashtag traction (e.g., #TikTokMadeMeBuyIt performance)

Number of competing TikTok Shop listings and saturation assessment (red flag: 50+ listings with 500+ reviews using the same content angle)

Google Trends data showing stable or growing year-round demand — no seasonal spikes

Cross-reference with Amazon Movers & Shakers or AliExpress hot products



Financial Viability





AliExpress supplier cost and estimated landed cost

Proposed selling price on TikTok Shop

Gross margin percentage (we target 50%+)

TikTok platform fee estimate (typically 2–8?pending on category)

Estimated net profit per unit after fees and affiliate commission budget



Virality & Content Signals



Number of videos with 100K+ views featuring this product in the last 30 days

Video save rate and share rate on top-performing product content

Frequency of buyer-intent comments ("where can I buy this?", "link?")

Whether multiple creators are filming the same product in different formats (signals scalability)

Watch-through rate benchmarks pulled from TikTok Creative Center



Evergreen & Problem-Solving Checklist





Does the product solve a clear, year-round consumer problem? (Required — this is non-negotiable)

Can the product's value be demonstrated visually within 3 seconds?

Does it pass the impulse buy test — low consideration, high visual appeal?

Are there competitor reviews pointing to pain points your listing can address?



Part 2 — Content Strategy Brief



For each validated product, you will submit a written brief that includes:





Why this product will grow through video content

Recommended video styles (e.g., POV demo, problem/solution, "I can't believe this exists," transformation reveal)

At least 3 hook variations to test

Target audience profile and the emotional trigger that drives the purchase decision







Part 3 — Video Creation & Publishing





Film and edit short-form videos using CapCut

Source trending audio, transitions, and TikTok-native formats to maximize reach

Post consistently and iterate based on real performance data

Track and report weekly on: views, watch time, click-through to shop, and conversion rate





Who We Are Looking For:



Demonstrated experience with TikTok Shop, TikTok organic content, or dropshipping

Familiar with research tools such as Kalodata, FastMoss, Minea, or TikTok Creative Center

You understand that TikTok is an entertainment engine first — you know how to stop a scroll

Proficient in CapCut for video editing

Detail-oriented: you document your research with real data, not just gut instinct

Clear written English communication





Compensation



Base salary: Negotiable depending on experience and output

Commission: Paid per video that crosses our agreed viral threshold (e.g., 100K+ views with measurable shop traffic)

Long-term position for the right person as our store scales





How to Apply



 us at 



Your
 subject line must be exactly:



TikTok Researcher — PROBLEMSOLVER



Any application with a different subject line will be deleted without being opened.



Inside your
, include the following — in this exact order:





The secret word — it is hidden in this job post. Start your
 with it. (Hint: it is one word, all caps, and relates directly to what we sell.)

Your answer to this question: Name one evergreen, problem-solving product you would pitch us right now. Why does it qualify? What metrics would you use to validate it?

A link to at least one TikTok video you created — your own account or client work

A brief description of your product research process — what tools do you use and how do you d
 a product is worth testing?





Applications that skip any of these four items will not be considered.





We are looking for someone who is hungry, data-driven, and genuinely excited about TikTok commerce. If that is you, we want to hear from you.

title: Experienced Dropshipping Product Researcher for Health & Beauty Ecommerce Brand
description:
We are a growing dropshipping ecommerce company focused on health, beauty, wellness, and personal care products like creams, patches, oils, drops, and similar items.



We are looking for an experienced Product Researcher who can help us find strong products to test in our online stores.

This is not an entry-level role. We need someone who already understands dropshipping product research, competitor research, Meta and
 Ad Library, product validation, creative swipes, advertorials, funnels, and basic margin checking.



Your main job is to find products that have real customer demand, clear pain points, active competitors, useful ad references, and good potential for testing. We want someone reliable, detail-oriented, and able to clearly explain why a product is worth testing, not just send random product links.



What You'll Do

1. Research health, beauty, wellness, and personal care products, including creams, patches, oils, drops, and similar items that sell well online.

2. Use Meta Ad Library to find active competitor ads and high-reach creatives.

3. Research competitor product pages, advertorials, funnels, and offers.

4. Find strong hooks, angles, pain points, and customer problems behind each product.

5. Check if there are enough swipes, ads, images, and references for creative production.

6. Tell whether a competitor is testing or scaling a product.

7. Check basic supplier availability, product cost, and margin potential when needed.

8. Organize product findings clearly in Google Sheets with links, screenshots, notes, and reasoning.

9. Explain why each product is worth testing.

10. Follow SOPs and improve the quality of your research over time.



What We Need From You

1. Previous dropshipping or ecommerce product research experience. Be ready to show examples.

2. Solid working knowledge of Meta Ad Library.

3. Strong understanding of competitor research and product validation.

4. Able to find active ads and tell if competitors are testing or scaling a product.

5. Comfortable researching health, beauty, wellness, and personal care products.

6. Organized and able to work in Google Sheets.

7. Good written English.

8. Detail-oriented and able to follow SOPs.

9. Able to explain your product reasoning clearly.

10. Reliable, responsive, and consistent with daily work.



Nice to Have

1. Experience with Shopify.

2. Experience with AliExpress, CJdropshipping, or other supplier platforms.

3. Experience with ClickUp, Slack, and Google Drive.

4. Experience with ad spy tools.

5. Experience researching products for the UK, US, EU, or similar markets.

6. Experience finding winning ad angles, hooks, and creative swipes.

7. Experience reviewing advertorial pages or ecommerce funnels.



Test Task Notice

There will be a short product research test task before hiring. The purpose is to check your real research skill, your ability to use Meta Ad Library, your understanding of competitors, and how clearly you can explain why a product is worth testing. Please do not apply if you are not experienced in dropshipping product research.



How to Apply

Start your application message with the word RESEARCH so we know you read the full job post. Messages that do not start with RESEARCH will be ignored.



In your message, include:

1. Your dropshipping or ecommerce product research experience.

2. Proof of past work, such as screenshots, sample sheets, or products you found.

3. The tools you have used for product research.

4. The niches or markets you have researched before.

5. One example of a product you found in the past and why it was a good product.

6. Your expected monthly salary.

7. Your availability and preferred working hours.



Please Answer These Questions

1. How many years of dropshipping or ecommerce product research experience do you have?

2. What tools do you use to find products and competitors?

3. How do you use Meta Ad Library to validate a product?

4. What makes a product worth testing in dropshipping?

5. What health, beauty, wellness, or personal care products have you researched before?

6. How do you check if a competitor product is actually active or performing?

7. What information would you include in a product research sheet?

8. Are you comfortable completing a product research test task before hiring?

9. What is your expected monthly salary for full-time work?

10. When can you start?

title: Strategic Project Manager
description:
This isn’t a typical Project Manager role.



WHO WE ARE

We're Averus Group,  three healthcare companies (Magnolia Hyperbarics, Cerebral Health, and Pacific Neuroscience Center) in the middle of a transformation. We're building real infrastructure across all three: SOPs, optimized workflows, agentic AI tools — the systems that change how the entire operation runs. The vision is clear and the ceiling is exponential. Right now there's one bottleneck: leadership can only move as fast as it can execute alone. That's where you come in.





THE ROLE 

We need a force multiplier. Someone we can hand a vision to — not a task list — who understands the intent, scopes it, builds it out to completion, and coordinates the people needed to make it real. You're fast. You're independent. You don't need to be walked through every step, and you don't stall the second an instruction isn't spelled out.

Your projects could come from any of our three clinics: building an SOP from scratch, streamlining a clinic workflow, standing up an AI process,  and anything in between. You take it, you own it, and you bring back something finished.

You don't need to know everything on day one. But you need to learn fast — fast enough to pick up our AI processes, our Claude Cowork environment, and the agentic tools we're building, and then run with them. You think past the task of why it matters and where it should go, and you bring ideas we didn't ask for. You hold the whole picture across three companies and don't lose the thread when we jump from one problem to the next.

This seat is senior enough to think and own strategy, and wired to execute on command. If you need a seat in every meeting to feel useful, this isn't it. If you'd rather be handed a hard problem and left alone to solve it — keep reading.



WHAT YOU’LL BE DOING

Day-to-day, here's what this looks like.

• Take a vision from leadership and build it out to completion — scoping, planning, and delivering finished work

• Own projects end to end across all three clinics — SOPs, streamlining, optimization, AI infrastructure

• Coordinate and guide the staff needed to put your projects into practice, not just hand off a plan

• Build SOPs and drive their adoption in Trainual; train the teams who'll use them

• Learn and run with our AI processes, agentic tools, and Claude Cowork environment, fast

• Manage multiple projects at once and hold context across entities as priorities shift in real time

• Think strategically — bring ideas, improvements, and solutions before they're requested

• Work fluently in Notion, Google Workspace, Asana, and Trainual



YOU'D BE A GREAT FIT IF...

• Have run projects start to finish on your own; concept to delivery

• Are genuinely AI-fluent: you already use modern AI and agentic tools to get real work done

• Learn new systems fast and figure things out without a manual

• Operate with high ownership — you bring back finished work, not a list of questions

• Can coordinate and move other people toward a goal, even ones you don't manage

• Think strategically and see around corners, not just the task in front of you

• Can hold a lot of moving pieces across multiple businesses without dropping any

• Are driven by results and quality, not recognition

• Communicate clearly in writing and work cleanly and independently

• Can reliably work with the U.S. Pacific business hours



Preferred: experience building or supporting AI/automation infrastructure, experience writing SOPs and driving adoption, familiarity with Claude / Claude Cowork and agentic tooling, prior experience supporting a founder or executive directly, and healthcare exposure.



WHAT YOU'LL GET

We take care of the people who take care of our patients.

• Paid Time Off — Recharge so you can perform at your best. We respect the time you take away from work.

• Sick Days — When life happens, it happens. Take the time you need to recover without the pressure.

• Fully Remote — Work remote with a team spread across time zones — autonomy and flexibility built in.

• Real Growth — This is a growing organization. As both brands scale, so do the opportunities for the people building them.

• A Team That Cares — We hire people who are bought into the mission. You'll work alongside others who understand why the work matters, not just what the work is.

• A Greater Mission — Every qualified booking you drive is a patient who gets access to treatment that could change their life. That's not marketing copy — that's the reality of what we do.



If you read this and thought that's exactly the kind of problem I want to own — we'd love to hear from you. Send your resume and a brief note on how you've taken something from idea to finished, start to end.

title: Sales Auditor and Coach
description:
WHO WE ARE



Averus Group is a healthcare management services organization (MSO) based in the Bay Area. We provide the operational backbone — systems, training, marketing, finance, and shared services — that lets our specialty clinics focus on delivering exceptional patient care. You won't be contracted to any single clinic; you'll be part of the Averus team that builds and runs the engine behind all of them.



Two of those clinics anchor this role:

• Cerebral Health is a specialty chiropractic neurology clinic focused on concussion, TBI, vestibular, and autonomic disorders — helping patients who've often been failed by the conventional system finally get answers and recover.

• Magnolia Hyperbarics is our hyperbaric oxygen therapy practice serving members and partners across the region.



Across both, the consultation and report-of-finding conversations aren't just clinical exchanges — they're the 
nt a patient d
 to invest in getting their life back. We're building a world-class sales enablement engine to make sure every one of those conversations is exceptional, and we're looking for the person to own it.





THE ROLE 



This is not a closing or quota-carrying sales role. You won't be selling to patients. Your core job is to make our clinicians dramatically better at the consultative conversations that turn prospective patients into committed ones.

You'll live inside an AI-powered sales workspace, audit clinical sales conversations against proven frameworks, and deliver sharp, usable coaching straight to our doctors — holding them accountable to a high standard and tracking their improvement over time. The large majority of this work is for Cerebral Health, with a smaller portion supporting Magnolia Hyperbarics calls and check-ins.

Alongside the coaching work, you'll support our marketing team and Director of Operations on sales-driven initiatives and outreach. This is a supporting part of the role, not the center of it — the heart of the job is auditing and coaching.

Think of yourself as the coach, the quality engine, and the systems-builder behind our sales conversations. Much of this is heads-down precision work — auditing, scoring, refining — paired with the people's skill to coach skilled professionals in a way that actually changes behavior.



WHAT YOU’LL OWN

Day-to-day, here's what this looks like.

• Call & transcript auditing. Review consultation, report-of-findings, and reevaluation conversations (primarily Cerebral Health, plus Magnolia check-ins) against our sales frameworks and scripts. Catch the small misses — the unasked pain question, the weak transition, the rushed close — that separate a good consult from a converting one.

• Coaching & accountability. Deliver weekly, specific, actionable feedback directly to our clinical team. Hold doctors accountable to standards, track improvement over time, and make hard feedback land in a way that actually changes behavior.

• AI workspace management. Operate, maintain, and continuously improve our AI-powered sales enablement workspace — running transcripts through it, refining prompts and rubrics, and strategically upgrading the system so its feedback gets sharper over time.

• Protocol adherence & refinement. Follow established workspace protocols precisely, while constantly looking for ways to make them better.

• Sales & marketing support. Partner with the marketing team and Director of Operations on sales-driven initiatives, and support Magnolia Hyperbarics with outreach and backend marketing work.



YOU'D BE A GREAT FIT IF...

• Detail-obsessed. You notice the things other people skim past. Nitpicky is a compliment to you.

• AI-native. You don't just "use ChatGPT" — you build, troubleshoot, and improve AI systems. You can own a workspace and make it better over time.

• A natural coach. You can take a messy conversation, identify the three things that mattered, and deliver that feedback so a skilled professional accepts it instead of getting defensive.

• Sales-literate. You may not have carried a quota, but you can recognize a strong discovery sequence, a missed pain point, and a clean close. You're a great judge of selling.

• Strategic. You think about the system, not just the task. You're always asking how to make the engine better.

• A strong communicator. Clear, direct, and warm. You build trust and authority with people who outrank you in their own domain.



MUST-HAVES

• Demonstrated experience in sales enablement, sales coaching/training, call QA, or a closely related role

• Hands-on fluency with AI tools — be ready to walk us through a workspace or AI system you personally set up and refined

• Strong feedback and coaching ability with professionals or experts

• Exceptional attention to detail and a systems mindset

• Excellent written and verbal English communication

• Ability to work full-time on Pacific Time hours, regardless of physical location

• Reliable workspace, hardware, and internet



NICE-TO-HAVES

• Background in healthcare, clinical, or professional-services sales environments

• Experience building and refining scoring rubrics or playbooks

• Experience supporting marketing or outreach initiatives

• Familiarity with hyperbaric, neurology, or rehab-adjacent services



WHAT YOU'LL GET

We take care of the people who take care of our patients.

• Paid Time Off — Recharge so you can perform at your best. We respect the time you take away from work.

• Sick Days — When life happens, it happens. Take the time you need to recover without the pressure.

• Fully Remote — Work remotely with a team spread across time zones — autonomy and flexibility built in.

• Real Growth — This is a growing organization. As both brands scale, so do the opportunities for the people building them.

• A Team That Cares — We hire people who are bought into the mission. You'll work alongside others who understand why the work matters, not just what the work is.

• A Greater Mission — Every qualified booking you drive is a patient who gets access to treatment that could change their life. That's not marketing copy — that's the reality of what we do.



HOW WE HIRE

Our interview process includes a live exercise: we'll hand you a real (anonymized) sales conversation transcript and ask you to audit it and tell us how you'd coach the person who ran it. This is the heart of the role, and it's how we'll know we've found the right person.

title: Bookkeeping Support VA
description:
About the Role

We're looking for a reliable, detail-oriented, and process-driven Bookkeeping Support Virtual Assistant to join our team in a long-term capacity. This is a dedicated backend support role — you will not be client-facing at any point.



Your primary focus is to own the daily preparation and processing of our bookkeeping workflows. Success in this role means completing the groundwork each day so that leadership can simply review and approve entries rather than starting from scratch. If you have strong bookkeeping experience with Australian small businesses, love creating structured workflows, and want a steady, long-term position to grow into, we want to hear from you.



Work Structure & Requirements

Schedule: Part-time to begin, around 10–15 hours per week, with excellent potential to scale up over time as we find our rhythm

Preferred Time Zone: AWST (Perth, Western Australia) business hours or close overlap; leadership operates primarily Monday–Thursday during school hours, so alignment during this window is highly valued

Compensation: $7–$8 USD per hour to start, with room to grow



Key Responsibilities

1. Daily Ledger Prep & Reconciliation



Perform accurate daily transaction coding and matching within Xero

Execute bank reconciliations and clean up discrepancies under established rules

Manage Hubdoc document matching, verification, and organized digital filing



2. Accounts Payable & Receivable Support



Handle accounts payable data entry, including entering bills, coding them to the correct accounts, and flagging due dates

Reconcile vendor and supplier statements to ensure accounts are perfectly balanced

Prepare clear payment run summaries for executive review

Assist with accounts receivable by drafting and raising invoices when required



3. Payroll, Data Admin & Internal Communication



Complete precise payroll data entry based on submitted timesheets

Chase internally flagged missing documents, receipts, or clarifications using our pre-built templates

Maintain absolute integrity across spreadsheets, tracking logs, and task managers



(Note: Leadership handles all direct client communication, ABA banking files, and any actions requiring BAS agent judgment.)

Required Skills & Experience



Xero Mastery: Hands-on, practical experience with Xero is absolutely essential

Australian Market Knowledge: Prior experience working with Australian small businesses, payroll structures, and tax coding is highly preferred

Tech Stack Bonus: Direct familiarity with Hubdoc is a strong bonus

Communication: Flawless written English with an ability to communicate status updates clearly and precisely to the internal team

Work Style: Highly organized, comfortable working independently once provided with a clear SOP, and possesses extreme attention to detail with near-zero tolerance for input errors

title: Executive Assistant to CEO
description:
Position Overview:



As the Executive Assistant to the CEO, you will play a pivotal role in ensuring the smooth and efficient functioning of the executive office. Your primary responsibility will be to provide comprehensive administrative support to the CEO, managing their schedule, and coordinating various tasks to enhance productivity. Your ability to maintain confidentiality, exercise sound judgment, and proactively handle administrative duties will contribute to the overall effectiveness of the CEO's office.





Pay Range: $8 per hour with a performance review scheduled after 90 days of employment. We believe in rewarding exceptional talents.





About Power Plus Systems:



Power Plus Systems LLC has been a dominant force in the residential electrical contracting industry for two decades, and we continue to lead the way. Our vision is to successfully wire 28,000 homes to completion by the year 2029, ensuring safe and efficient electrical solutions, thereby making a positive impact on the lives of our customers and communities. At Power Plus Systems, LLC, a position with us isn't just a job; it's an opportunity to grow and develop within a company that genuinely appreciates your contributions and dedication to our shared mission.





Objectives:

• Manage and organize the CEO's daily schedule, including meetings, appointments, and travel arrangements.

• Act as a gatekeeper, screening and prioritizing communications to the CEO.

• Coordinate and facilitate communication between the CEO and internal/external stakeholders.

• Anticipate the CEO's needs and proactively handle tasks to ensure optimal time management.

• Coordinate special projects and initiatives as assigned by the CEO.





Competencies:

• Exceptional organizational and multitasking skills, with keen attention to detail.

• Strong written and verbal communication skills.

• Ability to maintain confidentiality and exercise discretion in handling sensitive information.

• Proficient in using Microsoft Office and Google Suites.

• Familiarity with scheduling software; experience with additional productivity tools is an advantage.

• Strong interpersonal skills with the ability to interact effectively with individuals at all levels.

• Proactive problem solver and resourceful thinker.





Equipment Requirements:

• Must own a reliable computer or laptop capable of handling administrative tasks efficiently.

• Must own and actively use an iPhone and/or MacBook or Mac computer for efficient communication and task management.

• High-speed internet connection to support video calls, cloud-based collaboration, and remote work.





Physical Requirements:

• Extended periods of sitting at a desk and working on a computer.



Benefits:

• Growth opportunities in a well-established company.

• Ongoing training and professional development opportunities.

• Opportunity for advancement within the company.

• A supportive and collaborative work environment.

• Company-observed paid United States holidays (full time).

• Paid vacation.

If you are ready to join Power Plus Systems, LLC, a well-established residential electrical contractor that values its tea
mbers and offers excellent benefits, please submit your application through the link below.




/internationalcareers

We are hiring a strong operational leader for a UK property management business covering long-term rentals, HMOs, and short-stay / serviced accommodation.



This is not a general VA role and not a junior property admin role. We are looking for someone who can take ownership of the property operations function, manage people, control standards, and keep the department running without constant owner chasing.



You must already have strong hands-on knowledge of UK property management operations and also be capable of leading and managing a team. We are not looking for someone who only has admin experience or someone who is “willing to learn leadership later”.



Minimum non-negotiable requirements



Please apply only if you meet all of the following:



At least 2 years of direct experience in UK lettings / UK property management

At least 2 years of team leadership / people management experience

Strong working knowledge of UK long-term lettings

Strong working knowledge of property management systems, trackers, record keeping, and workflow control

Experience dealing with tenant enquiries, viewings, tenancy progression, referencing, tenancy setup, maintenance coordination, and landlord communication

Ability to manage and follow up on multiple live issues without dropping tasks

Strong written and spoken English

High attention to detail

Strong organisational discipline

Ability to hold other people accountable, not just do the work yourself





Strongly preferred





Experience with HMOs

Experience with UK compliance administration (EICR, gas safety, EPC, deposit protection, prescribed information, tenancy documents, council/water updates, etc.)

Experience managing remote staff or VAs

Experience building or improving SOPs, trackers, and workflows

Strong lettings and occupancy management experience

Experience coordinating property onboarding, furnishing, refurbishments, or launch/setup projects

Experience managing multiple delivery workstreams at the same time across operations, lettings, and project/setup work, for example refurbishment of a long-term rental property and furnishing/setup of a short-stay property.



What this role is responsible for





Leading and controlling the day-to-day property operations function

Managing or overseeing short-stay operational workflow

Overseeing tenant enquiry handling, viewings, applicant progression, and tenancy setup

Controlling maintenance workflow from report to resolution

Ensuring records, trackers, folders, and systems stay accurate and updated

Managing staff performance, follow-up, and accountability

Escalating only genuine owner-level issues

Helping improve systems, checklists, and operational discipline

Managing occupancy and void control across long-term and short-stay properties in line with agreed KPIs.

Ensuring property setup, furnishing, and refurbishment projects are coordinated and delivered on time, on budget, and in line with the agreed plan.



What success looks like





Property operations run in a controlled and predictable way

Tasks are not dropped

Staff are followed up and managed properly

Tenant, landlord, guest, and contractor communication is timely and professional

Maintenance and operational issues move forward without chaos

The owner is not dragged into routine chasing

Records, spreadsheets, and systems are accurate and usable

Problems are solved, not just reported





Important



This role requires both:



- strong UK property management knowledge, and

- real people-management ability



If you are excellent at doing tasks yourself but struggle to manage others, follow up on staff, or hold standards, this role is probably not the right fit.



To apply

Your CV

how many years you have worked directly with UK lettings / property management

what exact tasks and responsibilities you handled yourself

what UK systems / platforms / CRMs / software you used

title: Accountant / Bookkeeper
description:
We are looking for a highly detail-oriented and trustworthy Accountant / Bookkeeper to join our team. This is a full-time remote position with significant financial responsibility. The person in this role will be responsible for handling day-to-day bookkeeping, financial records, reconciliations, and supporting accurate financial reporting.

Accuracy is extremely important in this role. Small errors in data entry, reconciliations, or financial documentation can lead to serious issues such as incorrect reporting, compliance problems, or financial discrepancies. Because of this, we place very high importance on candidates who are careful, methodical, and take pride in producing accurate work.

We are looking for someone who can work independently, follow processes consistently, and communicate clearly when issues arise. This is not a high-volume data entry role. We are looking for someone who can think critically about the numbers and processes they are working with.



Key Responsibilities:

Perform daily bookkeeping tasks including recording transactions and maintaining accurate ledgers

Reconcile bank accounts, credit cards, and other financial accounts on a regular basis

Review financial documents for accuracy and completeness

Assist with month-end closing processes and basic financial reporting

Organize and maintain financial records in a clear and accessible manner

Identify and flag discrepancies or unusual items for review

Help document and improve internal financial processes over time



Requirements:

Strong attention to detail and a careful approach to financial work

Good understanding of basic accounting principles and bookkeeping practices

Ability to work independently and manage your own workload

Clear written communication skills in English

Comfortable using Google Sheets, Google Docs, and accounting software

Must be reliable and consistent with working hours



Why We Use a Rigorous Application Process:

This is a high-trust role that involves handling sensitive financial information. In the past, we found that our hiring process was not strict enough, and we ended up with people who were not suited for the level of care and accuracy this role requires. We are now being much more selective.

We use a two-part assessment to better understand how candidates think and work:



Part 1 tests your ability to carefully review documents and spot inconsistencies.

Part 2 tests how clearly and logically you can document a process.



These assessments help us see how you approach detailed work, not just whether you have prior experience. We are looking to hire someone for the long term who can grow with the role.

Please be aware that this application process is intentionally rigorous. If we receive a large number of applications, we will only move forward with a very small number of candidates. We respect your time and ask that you only apply if you are genuinely willing to put in serious effort during the assessments.

We do not accept AI-generated or low-effort responses. Generic answers are easy to identify and will result in disqualification. We are only interested in candidates who are willing to do the work themselves.

Compensation:

This position starts at $10 per hour. We offer performance-based bonuses and the opportunity to increase your hourly rate over time based on retention, consistency, and quality of work. We prefer to build long-term working relationships with people who demonstrate reliability and strong performance.

How to Apply:

Please apply through the link below and complete the full application, including both assessments. Only serious candidates who are prepared to put in genuine effort will be considered.

title: Landing Page Copywriter / Web Content Specialist for Industrial Container Products
description:
Job Description:



We are looking for a skilled landing page copywriter / web content specialist who can prepare content for 3 separate product landing pages in Ukrainian.



Important: you do not have to be a native Ukrainian speaker. You may use AI tools, translation tools or professional translation support to prepare the Ukrainian version. However, the final text must be clear, natural, professional and suitable for publication. We will verify the Ukrainian content before publishing.



Our company produces and supplies different types of container-based solutions for business, industrial, construction, logistics and specialist applications. We already have existing Polish websites with product descriptions, photos and company information. Your task will be to understand the current content, select the most important selling points, and transform it into clear, professional and persuasive Ukrainian landing page content.



This is not a simple translation job. We do not want to copy all information from our existing websites. We need concise, sales-oriented landing pages that present the product category, explain the value for the target market, and encourage potential clients, distributors or business partners to send an inquiry.



The project includes 3 landing pages:



1. Custom technical and industrial containers

A landing page presenting our production capabilities. We manufacture technical, industrial and specialist containers on individual order. The goal is to show that we can design and produce containers for many different technical applications, depending on the client’s needs.



Examples of applications include technical containers, industrial containers, energy storage containers, fire protection containers, pump station containers, chemical containers, electrical switchgear containers, server containers, boiler room containers and other custom-made solutions.



2. Flatpack / TRUCKPACK containers for wholesale orders

A landing page presenting flatpack modular containers for self-assembly. The key message is efficient logistics, fast delivery and wholesale cooperation. Up to 10 container modules can be transported on one truck, which significantly reduces transport costs.



Important: this offer is for wholesale / B2B orders only, not for single retail customers.



3. Protective / anti-fragmentation sea container project

A landing page for a new separate brand/project. The product is based on sea containers upgraded with a ballistic / anti-fragmentation protective coating. The containers can be adapted to different practical uses and project requirements.



Important: this page should not mention the name of our material supplier. We are creating a new independent brand for this product.



What we need from you:



* Create Ukrainian landing page copy for each of the 3 product categories.

* You may use AI or translation tools to prepare the Ukrainian content, but the final result must be polished and publication-ready.

* Structure each page as a professional offer page, not as a long technical article.

* Prepare strong headlines, subheadlines, benefit sections, product/application sections and call-to-action texts.

* Adapt the message to B2B clients, construction companies, industrial clients, distributors, public sector buyers or organizations looking for modular infrastructure.

* Make the content clear, trustworthy and focused on generating inquiries.

* Suggest improvements to the page structure if needed.

* Optional but welcome: propose CTA button texts, short form text, SEO title and meta description for each landing page.



You will receive:



* Links to our current websites.

* Product descriptions and reference information.

* Photos / visual materials if needed.

* General direction for each landing page.



Required skills:



* Experience in landing page copywriting.

* Good English or Polish communication.

* Ability to turn technical information into clear business benefits.

* Ability to prepare or coordinate Ukrainian-language content using AI, translation tools or other reliable methods.

* Understanding of B2B, industrial, construction, modular buildings or technical products will be a big advantage.

* Ability to work independently and ask smart questions when something is unclear.



Deliverables:



For each of the 3 landing pages:



1. Page title / main headline

2. Hero section text

3. Short product introduction

4. Key benefits section

5. Applications / use cases section

6. Why work with us section

7. Call-to-action section

8. CTA button text

9. Short contact form intro

10. SEO title and meta description



To apply, please send:



1. A short introduction about your experience.

2. Examples of landing pages, website copy or B2B content you have written.

3. Information on how you would prepare Ukrainian content — for example with AI, translation tools or Ukrainian language support.

4. Your total fixed price for preparing all 3 landing pages.

5. Alternatively, you may provide a separate fixed price for each landing page.

6. Please clearly state whether your price includes research, copywriting, Ukrainian translation/adaptation and revisions.

7. Estimated delivery time.

8. Number of revisions included in your price.



We are looking for someone who can create clear, strong and professional sales content — not just translate words.

title: Short-Form Series Producer — Vertical Drama (TikTok & Reels)
description:
## Short-Form Series Producer — Vertical Drama (TikTok & Reels)



**Location:** Fully remote · **Type:** Full-time · **Compensation:** Base + performance bonus tied to growth (see below) · **Reports to:** Founder



### About us



We're a stealth-stage narrative studio. We make and grow **serialized vertical drama** — DramaBox / ReelShort / micro-drama-style short-form storytelling built to hook in three seconds and keep people bingeing. This is not brand content and not advertising. It's drama, cut for the vertical feed.



### The role



You own the *growth and packaging* of our short-form drama accounts — the strategy, the hooks, the publishing, the data. You'll launch accounts from zero, shape what gets made and how it's framed for the feed, and engineer the hooks and cliffhangers that make people watch to the end and come back for the next part. You work hand-in-hand with our editor, who handles the cutting — you bring the plan and the brief, she brings the craft. You're equal parts storyteller and analyst: strong instincts for dramatic pacing, and you live in the retention data to know exactly where viewers drop and why. Read the "what we're looking for" section carefully; **when you apply, open your message with the word "CLIFFHANGER"** so we know you did. This is an ownership role: you set the content strategy, you ship daily, and you're measured on results.



### What you'll do



- Launch, run, and grow multiple TikTok and Instagram accounts publishing serialized vertical drama from a standing start.

- Own the content strategy: what series we make, how episodes are structured, and how each one is hooked and packaged for the feed.

- Brief and direct our editor — hand off clear cut directions, hook requirements, and episode beats, then refine based on what the data says.

- Engineer 3-second hooks, episode cliffhangers, and series structures that drive completion, saves, shares, and return viewers.

- Natively publish at volume and manage posting cadence, captions, hooks, and community engagement to compound reach.

- Read the data daily — retention curves, drop-off points, completion, follower velocity — and rapidly iterate.

- Stay ahead of micro-drama trends, formats, audio, and algorithm shifts and translate them into our content fast.



### What we're looking for



- A demonstrable track record growing **serialized or episodic** short-form accounts — bring the accounts and the real numbers (retention, completion, followers gained). Brand ads, product promos, and UGC ad spots are **not** what we're hiring for; please don't send them.

- Native fluency in narrative short-form: you understand hooks, cliffhangers, dramatic pacing, and binge mechanics by instinct *and* by data.

- A sharp eye for packaging and direction — you can articulate exactly why a cut works and brief an editor to nail it, even though you're not the one cutting.

- Genuinely data-literate: you make calls from retention curves, not vibes.

- High output, high iteration speed — you'd rather ship 20 tests and learn than polish one.

- Fully self-directed in a remote setting.



### Nice to have



- Experience with vertical micro-drama specifically (DramaBox, ReelShort, GoodShort, or similar platforms).

- On-camera or talent-direction experience.

- Scriptwriting for serialized formats.



### Compensation



- Competitive base **plus** a performance bonus tied to growth milestones (follower and qualified-reach targets per account). We deliberately weight pay toward upside — make the accounts grow, earn more.



### To apply



Reply with: (1) links to **serialized** accounts you've grown and the numbers behind them, (2) the opening hook of your best episode and the cliffhanger that ended it, and (3) one micro-drama series you think nails the format, and why. *(Applications without serialized examples won't be reviewed.)*

Fix listing errors, suppressed/stranded inventory, and category/attribute problems

Keep a clear tracker of each SKU's status (live / pending / blocked / needs info from us)

Flag anything that needs a decision or input from our team

Reliable internet and ability to work independently



Nice to have
